name: Yu Jin
lore: A veteran general of Cao Cao whose feats made him one of the Five Generals of Wei. Surrendering to Guan Yu at Fan Castle cost him the trust of Cao Cao and Cao Pi. Back in Wei, Cao Pi put his surrender on show; Yu Jin died of shame and rage.
battleCry:
Years of battle set us apart.
I will carve that difference into your flesh!
victoryCryDuel: Did you truly think you could best me?!
victoryCryBattle: A castle like this is nothing to me!

skill.name: Stealth
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW and puts it in Stealth. (Enemies can't see it, except for the moment it meets the same reveal conditions as an Ambush. Enemy Skills can still target it.)

name: Wang Yi
lore: A heroine of the Three Kingdoms, as strong as she was clever. When Ma Chao, beaten by Cao Cao, ran rampant, her scheme drove him out of Xiliang. When he attacked Qishan, she led troops herself, held off his fierce assault and drove him back.
battleCry:
Barbarian of Xiliang!
Never underestimate a woman's pride and resolve...
victoryCryDuel: You thought you could defeat me?
victoryCryBattle: A woman's pride and resolve won out.

skill.name: Fury Payback
skill.description: Greatly lowers the POW and SPD of enemies in range.
skill.shortDescription: Greatly lowers enemy POW and SPD

name: Jia Xu
lore: Under Zhang Xiu, he gave Cao Cao great trouble, then joined his staff before Guandu, outdoing nearly all of Cao Cao's strategists. Against Ma Chao, his 'Sowing Discord' scheme split Ma Chao from Han Sui, and their disordered army was crushed.
battleCry:
Heh heh heh... The human heart
is so easily read.
victoryCryBattle: Heh heh heh... Regret your foolish strategy.

skill.name: Divide Ploy
skill.description: Lowers the POW, INT and SPD of enemies in range. The effect is halved when only one Unit is affected.
skill.shortDescription:
Lowers enemy POW, INT and SPD
Halved if only 1 Unit is hit

name: Guo Jia
lore: Cao Cao's strategist, who foresaw the assassination of Sun Ce and the Yuan succession feud. On the northern campaign he caught a local disease and died at 38. Cao Cao later lamented that had Guo Jia lived, Red Cliffs would not have been lost.
battleCry:
Nothing can unfold
that these eyes have not foreseen...
victoryCryBattle: No turn of events escapes my far-seeing eye.

skill.name: Flash Speed
skill.description: Briefly raises the POW of allies in range. Horse Units among them also gain SPD.
skill.shortDescription:
Briefly raises ally POW
Horse Units also gain SPD

name: Lady Guo
lore: Wife of Cao Pi. Her beauty won her his undivided favor and the rank of Imperial Consort. Ambitious for more, she schemed against Lady Zhen: she planted false suspicions in Cao Pi, drove the empress to suicide and became empress herself.
battleCry:
The realm has no need of two queens.
Wouldn't you agree?
victoryCryDuel: You're so weak, it's simply appalling...
victoryCryBattle: Thank you. I'll be taking this, then.

skill.name: Weaken Ploy
skill.description: Lowers the POW of enemies in range.

name: Yue Jin
lore: A brave general raised in Cao Cao's own ranks. Small but fearless, he was always first into battle to win honors. At Guandu he cut down Yuan Shao's officer Chunyu Qiong, and at Hefei he drove back the Wu army with Zhang Liao and Li Dian.
battleCry:
Forward, men!
Retreat is not in our vocabulary!
victoryCryDuel: Did you think you could halt my advance?!
victoryCryBattle: Retreat is not in my vocabulary!

skill.name: Power Tactics
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW.

name: Xiahou Yuan
lore: A key retainer at Cao Cao's side since he first raised his banner, who with his cousin Xiahou Dun formed Cao Cao's two wings. Never one to fall back, he excelled at swift raids. He beat Ma Chao, who came out of Xiliang, and took Pang De alive.
battleCry:
My attack strikes like a gale.
You will fall in an instant!
victoryCryDuel: Did you see my attack, swift as a gale?!
victoryCryBattle: Next! On to the next! Let's keep going!

skill.name: Wild Shots
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW and makes it shoot every enemy Unit within its bow range.
skill.shortDescription:
Raises POW and shoots
every enemy within range

name: Xiahou Yuan
lore: A pillar of Cao Cao's army and cousin of Xiahou Dun, this veteran fought in every major battle, shining against Ma Chao and at Hanzhong. Left to hold Hanzhong, his boldness made him miss the moment to withdraw, and he fell to Huang Zhong.
battleCry:
No common general
can take the measure of my attack!
victoryCryDuel: Thought you could take my godspeed attack?
victoryCryBattle: None can take the measure of my attack!

skill.name: Speed Tactics
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW and SPD.

name: Xiahou Dun
lore: A one-eyed general who fought beside Cao Cao from the day he raised his banner. Modest in daily life, he turned demon-fierce in battle and won many feats. A stray arrow cost him his left eye fighting Lu Bu, yet his valor only grew keener.
battleCry: Mock my one eye and you die!
victoryCryDuel: Took me lightly for my one eye, did you?
victoryCryBattle: Surrender, and I will spare your life.

skill.name: One Eye Roar
skill.description: Briefly stops enemies in range from moving. This Unit's POW also rises: the more enemies in range, the bigger the increase. Once its POW has risen past a certain amount, its SPD rises too.
skill.shortDescription:
Halts enemies and raises POW
A big enough boost raises SPD too

name: Xiahou Dun
lore: First of Cao Cao's generals and his cousin. Fighting Lu Bu in Xu Province, he took an arrow in the left eye, ate the eyeball and fought on, cutting down the archer. Yet he was sincere and affable, and long remained Cao Cao's trusted counselor.
battleCry:
My parents gave me this eye.
I'm not about to throw it away!
victoryCryDuel: That won't stop my left eye throbbing!
victoryCryBattle: Is that it? That barely scratched the itch!

skill.name: Dispel Gaze
skill.description: Removes the effects of enemy Skills from enemy Units in range.

name: Niu Jin
lore: A Wei officer who served under Cao Ren defending Nan Commandery. When Wu forces attacked, he eagerly rode out to meet them but was surrounded. Cao Ren personally led a charge to break the encirclement and rescue him.
battleCry:
Mooooargh!
I'll charge in and smash 'em all!
victoryCryDuel: Mooooargh! Learned your lesson?!
victoryCryBattle: Mooooargh! Learned your lesson?!

skill.name: Reckless Rush
skill.description: Greatly raises this Unit's POW and SPD, but it is forced to move in the direction it faced when the Skill was used.
skill.shortDescription:
Greatly raises POW and SPD
but it runs straight ahead

name: Xu Chu
lore: A fierce general of Cao Cao, called the Tiger Fool for his tiger-like strength and dreamy manner. As captain of the guard he was always at his lord's side, saving him time and again. When Cao Cao died, he wept until he coughed blood.
battleCry: I'm gonna protect your life, Sir, I am!
victoryCryDuel: I took down the enemy general, I did!!
victoryCryBattle: I took this castle, I did!!

skill.name: Tiger Strength
skill.description: Greatly raises this Unit's POW.

name: Cai Wenji
lore: Daughter of Cai Yong and the most gifted woman of the Later Han, she wrote Eighteen Songs of a Nomad Flute among many works. Taken by the Xiongnu amid chaos in the capital, she wed their king until rescued, and back home wrote prodigiously.
battleCry:
Well, that'll do.
*Yawn*... Time for a little break...
victoryCryDuel: And that's that, all settled...
victoryCryBattle: Mm, mmmh... Oh, did I win?

skill.name: Heaven Dance
skill.description: [Dance] (Once used, this Unit can't move, but the effect lasts until it dies.) Raises the SPD of all allies except this Unit.

name: Cai Mao
lore: Liu Biao's officer who saw his lord's guest Liu Bei as a threat and twice failed to kill him. On Liu Biao's death he gave Jing Province to Cao Cao and became admiral, but Zhou Yu's ruse before Red Cliffs had him executed for collusion with Wu.
battleCry:
Behold the might of my navy,
born of Jing Province!
victoryCryDuel: That should make winning a bit easier.
victoryCryBattle: We have plenty of fight left in us yet!

skill.name: Power Tactics
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW.

name: Sima Yi
lore: On the death of Cao Rui, his will made Sima Yi and Cao Shuang guardians of the child emperor. Sidelined by Cao Shuang's faction, he feigned frailty from illness to lull them, then purged them in a coup. His power in Wei became immense.
battleCry:
Before my intellect,
you are but a child.
victoryCryBattle: Win in the end, and that is all that matters.

skill.name: Fluid Tactics
skill.description: Removes the effects of enemy Skills from enemies in range and lowers their POW. If allies in range outnumber the enemies there, it instead raises the POW, INT and SPD of allies in range.
skill.shortDescription:
Raises ally POW, INT and SPD, or
clears enemy Skills and lowers POW

name: Xun Yu
lore: The foremost civil official in Cao Cao's army, he upheld all affairs of war and state and was hailed from youth as having the talent to aid a king. An early follower, he held the home front while Cao Cao campaigned, often saving the army.
battleCry:
To bring peace to this chaos,
I shall do my utmost.
victoryCryBattle: To serve conquest for peace is a just path.

skill.name: Mystery Counter
skill.description: [Deny] (Usable only when an enemy within range uses a Skill. A Deny can't be Denied.) Cancels the enemy's Skill. If that Skill deals damage, its effect is reflected back.
skill.shortDescription: Cancels the Skill and reflects damage

name: Xun You
lore: Nephew of Xun Yu, though six years older. Jailed for plotting to kill Dong Zhuo, he joined Cao Cao on Xun Yu's word. He looked dull but hid great wisdom; Cao Cao praised him as soft without, steel within, and he long served as his strategist.
battleCry:
Ha ha ha! Well, well...
You've got me there!
victoryCryBattle: Well, things have a way of working out, eh?

skill.name: Great Flood
skill.description: Deals water damage to enemies in range. The damage depends on this Unit's INT against the target's.

name: Zhong Hui
lore: Zhong Yao's youngest son, called a prodigy from childhood. He became Sima Zhao's confidant, crushing rebellions and conquering Shu with Deng Ai. Ambitious, he plotted rebellion with Jiang Wei, but Sima Zhao saw through him and had him killed.
battleCry:
This is not betrayal.
It is knowing how to get ahead!
victoryCryDuel: Our talents are simply worlds apart.
victoryCryBattle: The only path left to you is to follow me!

skill.name: Water Bane
skill.description: Deals water damage to enemies in range. The damage depends on this Unit's INT against the target's.

name: Xu Huang
lore: A fierce axe-wielding general who shone at Guandu. At Red Cliffs he led the vanguard, then guarded Cao Cao all the way back to the capital. Risen from the ranks yet cautious, he always planned for the worst and never suffered a major defeat.
battleCry:
Do not pursue too far.
Finish the enemy off for certain!
victoryCryDuel: Heh. My great axe stung, didn't it?
victoryCryBattle: Victory always arrives, sure and certain!

skill.name: Speed Tactics
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW and SPD.

name: Lady Zhen
lore: One of the great beauties of the era, she won the undivided love of Cao Pi, first emperor of Wei. Even his father Cao Cao and brother Cao Zhi are said to have loved her. Yet she was noble at heart: fair, just, and a support to all around her.
battleCry:
Allow me to lend a hand
in your quest for supremacy.
victoryCryDuel: Tired already, were you?
victoryCryBattle: That went rather well, I think.

skill.name: Outnumber Dance
skill.description: [Dance] (Once used, this Unit can't move, but the effect lasts until it dies.) Raises allies' POW. The more the enemy Units on the field outnumber your Units still standing, the bigger the increase.
skill.shortDescription:
[Dance] The more you are outnumbered,
the more ally POW rises

name: Cao Hong
lore: Cao Cao's cousin. When Cao Cao, chasing Dong Zhuo, was beaten and lost his horse to arrows, Cao Hong gave him his own mount. Guarding him on foot, he got Cao Cao across the river and survived the enemy's pursuit. A man of loyalty and valor.
battleCry:
The world can do without me,
but not without you, Sir!
victoryCryDuel: I can't very well die here, you see.
victoryCryBattle: That was a hard-fought victory...!

skill.name: Kamikaze
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW and Siege power, but it is forced to advance while the effect lasts.
skill.shortDescription:
Raises POW and Siege power
but forces it to advance

name: Cao Ang
lore: Cao Cao's eldest son. Campaigning against Zhang Xiu, who had surrendered, Cao Cao was hit by a night raid and his horse was shot as he fled. Cao Ang rushed to him and gave up his own horse. Cao Cao escaped, but Cao Ang fell to enemy arrows.
battleCry:
Whoever stands in my father's way,
I, Cao Ang Zixiu, will not forgive!
victoryCryDuel: The brigand after Father's life is slain!
victoryCryBattle: Father, I have cleared the way for you!

skill.name: Take My Horse!
skill.description: Raises the POW and SPD of the ally with the highest POW on the field, other than this Unit. This Unit dies on activation.
skill.shortDescription:
Strongest ally gains POW and SPD
This Unit dies

name: Cao Zhang
lore: Son of Cao Cao. A born lover of war, strong enough to wrestle wild beasts, he left the place of heir to his elder brother Cao Pi to live as a warrior. After crushing the Wuhuan revolt, he rushed to Hanzhong and beat Liu Feng's forces.
battleCry:
Ha! The battle I've longed for!
Forward! One or two generals' heads
won't be enough to stop me!
victoryCryDuel: Not yet! I've not had nearly enough!
victoryCryBattle: War is grand! It sets my heart racing!

skill.name: Flash Strength
skill.description: Greatly raises this Unit's POW for a short time.
skill.shortDescription: Greatly raises POW for a short time

name: Cao Zhi
lore: Third son of Cao Cao, gifted in letters from childhood and prized by his father, but his free spirit cost him the succession. When his brother Cao Pi moved to execute him, he met the challenge to compose a poem in seven steps and was spared.
battleCry:
Poetry springs forth
at any moment.
victoryCryBattle: I feel a new poem taking shape...

skill.name: Dispel Ploy
skill.description: Removes the effects of enemy Skills from enemy Units in range.

name: Cao Ren
lore: Cao Cao's cousin. He raised troops to join Cao Cao against Dong Zhuo and fought like a lion in many battles. Named Governor of Guangyang by the court, he was kept at Cao Cao's side for his wits and courage. He rose to Grand Marshal of Wei.
battleCry:
Cao Cao's path to dominion!
I shall carve it open!
victoryCryDuel: What, finished already?!
victoryCryBattle: My strength sent a jolt through you, eh?

skill.name: Speed Tactics
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW and SPD.

name: Cao Cao
lore: A central figure of the Three Kingdoms, gifted at swordplay, strategy, government, letters and the arts, hailed as a hero beyond his age. His brilliance beat rival warlords one by one, laying the foundations of Wei, China's mightiest power.
battleCry:
Now is the time to soar!
My ambition reaches a thousand miles!
victoryCryDuel: This victory, too, is part of my destiny!
victoryCryBattle: Now I soar! My ambition spans a thousand miles!

skill.name: Lord's Appeal
skill.description: Raises the POW of all Wei allies in range.

name: Cao Pi
lore: Cao Cao's second son, who had Emperor Xian abdicate to him and became Emperor Wen. Schooled by his father, he was gifted in many arts. As emperor he enacted fine policies and raised able men, bringing stability to Wei, but died at just 40.
battleCry:
I, Cao Pi,
shall forge a new era!
victoryCryDuel: My realm has no place for you.
victoryCryBattle: Kneel before me, king of all the realm!

skill.name: Wei War Order
skill.description: Raises the POW of Wei allies in range for a long time.
skill.shortDescription: Raises Wei ally POW for a long time

name: Zhang He
lore: A fierce Wei general Cao Cao likened to the great Han general Han Xin. Adaptable, he read both battle and terrain. From the Yellow Turbans to his death in Zhuge Liang's northern campaigns, he fought for over 40 years, a warrior to the bone.
battleCry:
On the battlefield closest to death,
I feel most alive.
victoryCryDuel: I've fought far more battles than you!
victoryCryBattle: Victory, is it? I've long since lost count.

skill.name: Wei Elite
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW for a long time.
skill.shortDescription: Raises POW for a long time

name: Zhang Chunhua
lore: Wife of Sima Yi, and a fearsome woman. When a maid saw her husband feigning illness to dodge Cao Cao's offer of office, she killed the girl to silence her. Sima Yi, it is said, feared her so much he never stood up to her all his life.
battleCry:
Hee hee, don't you worry, dear.
I've already wrung the neck
of that dirty little rat...
victoryCryDuel: Silencing loose tongues is my specialty.
victoryCryBattle: My quiet scheming behind the scenes paid off.

skill.name: Stealth
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW and puts it in Stealth. (Enemies can't see it, except for the moment it meets the same reveal conditions as an Ambush. Enemy Skills can still target it.)

name: Zhang Liao
lore: A Wei general so feared that Wu soldiers cried 'Zhang Liao is coming!' At Hefei, Sun Quan laid siege with 100,000 men. Zhang Liao sallied with just 800, smashing the Wu army. His assault was so fierce he nearly took Sun Quan's head.
battleCry:
My target: Sun Quan's head.
Anyone in my way dies!
victoryCryDuel: All who stand in my way, I cut down!
victoryCryBattle: It seems none can stand against my might!

skill.name: Speed Order
skill.description: Raises the POW of allies in range. Horse Units among them also gain SPD.
skill.shortDescription:
Raises ally POW
Horse Units also gain SPD

name: Cheng Yu
lore: Cao Cao's strategist, recommended by Xun Yu. Born Cheng Li, he dreamed in youth of holding up the sun, so Cao Cao added the sun to his name, making it Yu. At Cangting, his Ten-Sided Ambush hid troops in ten places and crushed Yuan Shao's army.
battleCry:
I see it... my sun rising
to the throne!
victoryCryBattle: Sir, I see heaven within our reach.

skill.name: Stealth
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW and puts it in Stealth. (Enemies can't see it, except for the moment it meets the same reveal conditions as an Ambush. Enemy Skills can still target it.)

name: Dian Wei
lore: Cao Cao's mighty bodyguard, who stood by him all day and barely slept. When Zhang Xiu, who had surrendered, turned and raided the camp, Dian Wei covered Cao Cao's retreat, then stood fast at the gate and fought until his strength gave out.
battleCry:
...Sir.
May fortune favor you in battle...!
victoryCryDuel: I am the mighty E Lai reborn!
victoryCryBattle: So long as I stand, we shall not lose!

skill.name: Flash Strength
skill.description: Greatly raises this Unit's POW for a short time.
skill.shortDescription: Greatly raises POW for a short time

name: Deng Ai
lore: The Wei general who brought down Shu late in the era. On the Shu front he repeatedly beat Jiang Wei and shot Xiahou Ba dead. Sent by Sima Zhao to take Shu, he crossed sheer cliffs, beat Zhuge Zhan, fell on Chengdu and made Liu Shan surrender.
battleCry:
What awaits at the end
of this battle...?
victoryCryDuel: Why throw your life away so carelessly...?
victoryCryBattle: What awaits at the end of this battle...?

skill.name: Stealth Speed
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW and SPD and puts it in Stealth. (Enemies can't see it, except for the moment it meets the same reveal conditions as an Ambush. Enemy Skills can still target it.)
skill.shortDescription:
Raises POW and SPD
and grants Stealth

name: Lady Bian
lore: Cao Cao's wife and mother of Cao Pi, Cao Zhang, and Cao Zhi. Once a humble singer, she won Cao Cao's heart. Wise and modest, even as empress she never craved power, quietly supporting her husband from the shadows.
battleCry:
Because I am a king's wife,
I ask for nothing and help my husband.
Nothing is worth more than honor.
victoryCryDuel: A lovely song has just come to me.
victoryCryBattle: Allow me to sing you a song of victory.

skill.name: Sunset Dance
skill.description: [Dance] (Once used, this Unit can't move, but the effect lasts until it dies.) Allies' Siege Gauges fill faster, but their Siege power drops.
skill.shortDescription:
[Dance] Ally Siege Gauges fill faster
but their Siege power drops

name: Pang De
lore: Ma Chao's right hand, he joined Wei after Cao Cao beat them. To show he would fight Shu, where Ma Chao had gone, he went to war bearing a coffin, and matched Guan Yu for over 100 bouts. Taken by a ruse, he refused to yield and was executed.
battleCry:
Either I die, or Guan Yu does.
There's no other outcome!
victoryCryDuel: Who wants to fill the next coffin?
victoryCryBattle: My resolve will not be broken so easily!

skill.name: Kamikaze
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW and Siege power, but it is forced to advance while the effect lasts.
skill.shortDescription:
Raises POW and Siege power
but forces it to advance

name: Man Chong
lore: Recommended by Liu Ye to serve Cao Cao. Upright and incorruptible, at Fan Castle when Cao Ren wanted to retreat, he explained the position's importance and held firm. At Hefei he used stratagems to repel Wu, a true master of defense.
battleCry:
Leave it to me!
I'll defend this place to the death!
victoryCryDuel: Come back when you're stronger!
victoryCryBattle: It is defense that opens the way to victory.

skill.name: Chain Ploy
skill.description: Lowers the SPD of enemies in range.

name: Yang Hu
lore: Maternal grandson of Cai Yong, brother-in-law of Sima Shi, handsome, learned and eloquent. Facing Lu Kang across the Yangzi, he treated his rival with honor. When Lu Kang died he urged an attack on Wu but died first; Du Yu carried on his will.
battleCry:
Even against enemies,
I act with honor and trust.
victoryCryDuel: Return to the earth.
victoryCryBattle: In a contest, I keep personal feelings aside.

skill.name: Flash Order
skill.description: Briefly raises the POW of allies in range.

name: Li Dian
lore: A general from Cao Cao's earliest days. A scholar at heart, always calm in battle, respected by his men. He served as lieutenant in many campaigns, cautioning rash officers. Perhaps too cautious; no great victories bear his name.
battleCry:
General, you're too far forward!
Please, show some restraint!
victoryCryDuel: Your strikes were rather predictable.
victoryCryBattle: Fighting with caution is what leads to victory.

skill.name: Counter Ploy
skill.description: [Deny] (Usable only when an enemy within range uses a Skill. A Deny can't be Denied.) Cancels the enemy's Skill. If that Skill deals damage, its effect is reflected back.
skill.shortDescription: Cancels the Skill and reflects damage

name: Liu Ye
lore: Descended from a son of Emperor Guangwu of Han, he served Cao Cao, Cao Pi and Cao Rui. As Han royalty he kept aloof, yet was close to Lu Su of Wu. A keen judge of men, he urged the conquest of Zhang Lu and saw through Meng Da's betrayal.
battleCry: Heh, just what a fool would think.
victoryCryBattle: You saw this coming, didn't you?

skill.name: See Through
skill.description: [Deny] (Usable only when an enemy within range uses a Skill. A Deny can't be Denied.) Cancels the enemy's Skill.

name: Yi Ji
lore: Once a retainer of Liu Biao, he was impressed by Liu Bei's insight and served him after Liu Biao died. A skilled diplomat, he won over Sun Quan with his eloquence as envoy to Wu. Later he drew up the Shu Code with Zhuge Liang and Fa Zheng.
battleCry:
Well now...
I do hope they're the reasonable sort.
victoryCryBattle: I am glad to have been of some use.

skill.name: Apt Support
skill.description: Restores the HP of the ally with the highest POW in range.

name: Wang Ping
lore: A loyal officer under Zhuge Liang. Risen from the ranks and prized for his steadiness, he was Ma Su's deputy on the Northern Campaign. At Jieting he urged Ma Su not to defy orders, but was ignored; they were routed. Later he won many honors.
battleCry:
Blast, it can't be helped!
I'll hold this ground myself!
victoryCryDuel: It seems you were a little too reckless...
victoryCryBattle: Mission accomplished. Returning to base!

skill.name: Great Wheel
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW and makes its spear Thrust hit in all directions.
skill.shortDescription:
Raises POW and spear Thrust
hits in all directions

name: Xiahou Yueji
lore: Wife of Zhang Fei and niece of Xiahou Yuan. Zhang Fei, then apart from Liu Bei, met her by chance and fell for her. He was Liu Bei's sworn brother, she one of the Xiahou, Cao Cao's closest allies. What feelings bridged that divide is unknown.
battleCry:
Well, this must be fate.
I'll fight alongside you!
victoryCryDuel: You were pretty strong, actually.
victoryCryBattle: Looks like you and I weren't meant to be.

skill.name: Lightning
skill.description: Drops 3 lightning bolts in range, each dealing lightning damage to one of the enemies there. The damage depends on this Unit's INT against the target's.

name: Guan Yu
lore: A hero who swore the Peach Garden Oath with Liu Bei and Zhang Fei. Riding Red Hare and wielding the Green Dragon Blade, he was called a god of war, worth ten thousand. Escorting Liu Bei's wives, he broke through five passes to rejoin his lord.
battleCry: None can match the might of Guan Yu!!
victoryCryDuel: Your error was drawing a blade on Guan Yu!
victoryCryBattle: Drop your weapons! Yield to Guan Yu!

skill.name: Loyal Order
skill.description: Raises the POW of allies in range and restores their HP, even beyond the maximum.
skill.shortDescription:
Raises ally POW and restores
their HP beyond the maximum

name: Guan Yu
lore: Sworn brother of Liu Bei and Zhang Fei, and Liu Bei's foremost general. Deeply righteous, he was utterly loyal to Liu Bei. When he surrendered to Cao Cao, who heaped gifts on him to win him over, Guan Yu returned them all and rejoined Liu Bei.
battleCry:
All of my might...
I shall wield for my elder brother!
victoryCryDuel: Now you know the Green Dragon Blade's edge!
victoryCryBattle: While Guan Yu stands, there is no defeat.

skill.name: Long Spear
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW and lengthens its spear.

name: Guan Yinping
lore: Guan Yu's third daughter, valiant like her father. Though a woman, she reportedly fought in Zhuge Liang's Nanman campaign. Sun Quan sought her for his son, but Guan Yu refused: 'No tiger's cub for a dog's pup!' Ties between Shu and Wu soured.
battleCry:
This valor I got from Father
isn't just for show!
victoryCryDuel: What, did my father's name scare you off?
victoryCryBattle: Weakling! Father wouldn't go so easy on you!

skill.name: Young Awaken
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW: the higher the top POW among your Shu allies, the bigger the increase. Once its POW has risen past a certain amount, its spear Thrust also hits in all directions.
skill.shortDescription:
Raises POW; a big enough boost
adds Thrust in all directions

name: Lady Gan
lore: Liu Bei's wife and mother of Liu Shan, who would inherit Shu. A gentle woman who encouraged her struggling husband and remained devoted even when captured. An unseen pillar of support, she died young after the Battle of Red Cliffs.
battleCry:
It's all right, dear.
I'm sure things will work out!
victoryCryDuel: See? Things do work out somehow...
victoryCryBattle: Hee hee, thanks for letting me win!

skill.name: Healing Dance
skill.description: [Dance] (Once used, this Unit can't move, but the effect lasts until it dies.) All allies except this Unit keep recovering HP.

name: Guan Ping
lore: Guan Yu's adopted son. A rising young general, he won many honors alongside Liu Feng, Liu Bei's adopted son. When Wu struck Guan Yu from behind in Jing Province, father and son fought to the bitter end and died together.
battleCry:
Burn this sight into your eyes!
This is how Guan Ping lives!
victoryCryDuel: Thought you could beat the War God's son?!
victoryCryBattle: Father! Guan Ping has done it!

skill.name: Long Spear
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW and lengthens its spear.

name: Jian Yong
lore: From Liu Bei's hometown, his longest-serving follower, with him since he first raised troops. He was Liu Bei's confidant and often his envoy. Careless and arrogant, he still made no enemies, thanks no doubt to his humor and likable nature.
battleCry:
Now, now, now.
This ought to do, eh?
victoryCryBattle: Wahahaha! Well, that's about how it goes!

skill.name: Bloodless Fall
skill.description: Greatly raises this Unit's Siege power but lowers its POW. The less battle time remains, the stronger the effect.
skill.shortDescription:
Raises Siege power, lowers POW
Stronger as the clock runs down

name: Wei Yan
lore: A fierce general who won renown in the conquest of Shu. Liu Bei prized his valor so highly he chose him over Zhang Fei to hold Hanzhong. After Liu Bei died he followed Zhuge Liang on the Northern Campaign, winning glory by slaying Wang Shuang.
battleCry:
Isn't anyone reckless enough
to take me on!?
victoryCryDuel: You're no match for me!
victoryCryBattle: This castle is mine, all mine!

skill.name: I Alone
skill.description: All of your other Units in range die, and this Unit's POW rises: the more Units die, the bigger the increase. Once its POW has risen past a certain amount, its SPD rises too.
skill.shortDescription:
Allies in range die, POW rises
A big enough boost raises SPD too

name: Wei Yan
lore: A fierce general under Liu Bei. A mere captain at first, his many feats made him Governor of Hanzhong. Bold and proud, he was at odds with Zhuge Liang after Liu Bei's death, and his plan for a surprise attack on Changan was rejected.
battleCry:
Small fry!
You cannot bar the way of the great Wei Yan!
victoryCryDuel: Small fry!
victoryCryBattle: Is there no one who can defeat me?!

skill.name: Great Wheel
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW and makes its spear Thrust hit in all directions.
skill.shortDescription:
Raises POW and spear Thrust
hits in all directions

name: Jiang Wei
lore: Zhuge Liang's pupil, skilled in letters and arms, who matched Zhao Yun in a clash. After his master died he became Grand General and fought on against Wei to little effect. He plotted revolt with Wei's Zhong Hui, but failed and was cut down.
battleCry:
Your last wish, to bring down Wei...
I have taken it up as my own.
victoryCryDuel: Couldn't read my spear, could you?
victoryCryBattle: The battle is over. Bring in the wounded.

skill.name: Provoke
skill.description: Makes every enemy in range move toward this Unit.

name: Yan Yan
lore: A former general of Liu Zhang. He refused to surrender, demanding, 'Cut off my head!', but Zhang Fei persuaded him to join Liu Bei. At Mount Tiandang he and Huang Zhong, two old warriors, charged boldly uphill and slew the enemy commander.
battleCry:
Ho, Lord Huang Zhong!
Let us scatter these greenhorns!
victoryCryDuel: Greenhorn! Come back when you've grown up!
victoryCryBattle: I'm not losing to you young'uns just yet!

skill.name: Fury Tactics
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW and restores its HP.

name: Wu Yi
lore: Once Liu Zhang's general, he surrendered when captured in Liu Bei's invasion of Shu. When Liu Bei became King of Hanzhong, he wed Wu Yi's sister and made Wu Yi General of the Left. After Liu Bei died he fought on many fronts under Zhuge Liang.
battleCry:
If I can aid Lord Liu Bei,
I'll take any role.
victoryCryDuel: I'd have liked to fight a little longer.
victoryCryBattle: A decent result, I'd say.

skill.name: Apt Support
skill.description: Restores the HP of the ally with the highest POW in range.

name: Huang Yueying
lore: Wife of the genius strategist Zhuge Liang. Versed in astronomy, geography, and military arts, she supported him with her vast knowledge. Said to be an inventor, she created the wooden ox and flowing horse, and mechanical puppets.
battleCry: Oh! I think I just hit on the perfect plan.
victoryCryDuel: Wow, that took me by surprise!
victoryCryBattle: Now then, how shall I remodel this castle?

skill.name: Yellow Accel
skill.description: Raises this Unit's SPD.

name: Huang Zhong
lore: Shu's white-haired veteran, a master archer once under Liu Biao. Facing Liu Bei, in a clash with Guan Yu he fell from his wounded horse, but Guan Yu spared him to fight fair. Next time, able to shoot Guan Yu, he hit only his cap to repay him.
battleCry: Lord Guan Yu, with this I have repaid my debt.
victoryCryDuel: Such childish swordplay won't work on me.
victoryCryBattle: Hmph, still wet behind the ears, I see.

skill.name: Zero Range
skill.description: Greatly raises this Unit's POW but shortens its bow range.

name: Huang Zhong
lore: One of Shu's Five Tiger Generals, a byword for growing bolder with age. In the battle for Hanzhong he teamed with fellow veteran Yan Yan and slew Wei's Xiahou Yuan. Though old, he fought at Yiling, cutting deep into the enemy until he fell.
battleCry:
Come, Lord Yan Yan!
We can't leave this to youngsters!
victoryCryDuel: Whelp! Have you learned your lesson?!
victoryCryBattle: Old, yet ever more vigorous: that is me!

skill.name: Aged Valor
skill.description: (Growing ever stronger with age) Raises this Unit's POW and restores its HP, even beyond the maximum.
skill.shortDescription:
Raises POW and restores HP
beyond the maximum

name: Zhou Cang
lore: A former mountain bandit who chose to serve Guan Yu and became his right hand in every battle. When Guan Yu flooded out Wei's Pang De, who fled by boat, Zhou Cang rammed it with a raft, sank it and seized him alive after a fight in the water.
battleCry:
Hraaah!
Watch how I live, damn you!!
victoryCryDuel: Hraaah! The win is mine!
victoryCryBattle: Hraaah! Watch how I live, damn you!!

skill.name: Power Tactics
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW.

name: Zhuge Liang
lore: The era's third hero, beside Liu Bei and Cao Cao. Won by Liu Bei's three visits, he devised the plan to split the realm in three. His uncanny statecraft made Liu Bei founder and emperor of Shu. After Liu Bei died he fought on against Wei.
battleCry:
Cao, Sun, and Liu.
This shall be the 'Three Kingdoms.'
victoryCryBattle: With this, the realm is divided in three!

skill.name: 8 Trigrams
skill.description: Gives allies in range an effect based on their number: 1 Unit: POW rises and HP is restored beyond the maximum. 2 Units: POW and SPD rise. 3 Units: POW rises and enemy Skills can't target them. 4 or more: POW rises and HP slowly recovers.
skill.shortDescription:
Gives allies in range various
effects, depending on their number

name: Xu Shu
lore: Liu Bei's first strategist. With brilliant tactics, he broke Cao Ren's 'Eight Gates Golden Lock' formation and won at Xinye. Cao Cao schemed to separate him from Liu Bei, but before leaving, Xu Shu recommended Zhuge Liang as his replacement.
battleCry:
Seems the other side, too,
has been doing a lot of thinking.
victoryCryBattle: I see it... your realm, Sir.

skill.name: Lightning
skill.description: Drops 3 lightning bolts in range, each dealing lightning damage to one of the enemies there. The damage depends on this Unit's INT against the target's.

name: Sun Ren
lore: Sun Quan's sister, who married Liu Bei to seal the Shu-Wu alliance. Fierce as any man, she matched Wu's generals in valor. Though wed for politics, she loved Liu Bei, her hero; at news of his death she reportedly threw herself into the Yangzi.
battleCry:
Go on, now!
Win no matter what, and come home!
victoryCryDuel: My sword's not half bad, wouldn't you say?
victoryCryBattle: Don't underestimate me for being a woman!

skill.name: Paralyze Arrow
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW and bow range, and its arrows lower the SPD of the enemies they hit.
skill.shortDescription:
Raises POW and range
Its arrows lower enemy SPD

name: Zhao Yun
lore: A brave general under Liu Bei, both calm and bold. He served Liu Bei and Zhuge Liang closely. At Changban, he rode alone through Cao Cao's army to rescue the infant Liu Shan, carrying the baby through enemy ranks to safety.
battleCry:
Now is the moment for Zhao Zilong
to show the grit of a lifetime!
victoryCryDuel: No man's blade shall get past my guard!
victoryCryBattle: Have you seen the true grit of Zhao Zilong?!

skill.name: Horse Unity
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW and SPD, and it takes no damage from Spear Counters.
skill.shortDescription:
Raises POW and SPD
No damage from Spear Counters

name: Zhao Yun
lore: One of the Five Tiger Generals, a bold yet careful Shu hero as valiant as Guan Yu and Zhang Fei. At Changban, when Liu Bei's family was left among the enemy, Zhao Yun felt responsible, charged in alone and came back with the infant Liu Shan.
battleCry:
I won't hesitate!
I will carry out my duty!
victoryCryDuel: To protect our land, I must not lose!
victoryCryBattle: I am Zhao Zilong! Yield and come quietly!

skill.name: Speed Tactics
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW and SPD.

name: Zhang Song
lore: Liu Zhang's officer, ugly and ill-mannered but brilliant. Mocked by Cao Cao as envoy to Wei, he recited Cao Cao's 'Mengde New Book' word for word. Later he invited Liu Bei into Yi Province, but was exposed and killed before Chengdu fell.
battleCry:
That old thing?
In Shu, even children know it by heart.
victoryCryBattle: Even a child of Shu could win this.

skill.name: Guide to Shu
skill.description: Makes every enemy in range move toward this Unit.

name: Zhang Fei
lore: Guan Yu's equal, a warrior worth a thousand. When Liu Bei was with Liu Biao, Cao Cao attacked with a million men. On the retreat Zhang Fei stood alone at Changban Bridge, defying the foe. Cao Cao's men fell back in fear and Liu Bei escaped.
battleCry:
Ten thousand men can't stand against me!
Don't take Zhang Fei's might lightly!
victoryCryDuel: That fight left me wanting more!
victoryCryBattle: Let my name be carved into your flesh!

skill.name: Provoke
skill.description: Makes every enemy in range move toward this Unit.

name: Zhang Fei
lore: A hero sworn to Liu Bei and Guan Yu by the Peach Garden Oath. Rough and harsh with his men but soft on Liu Bei, he followed him to the end, however low he fell. With a serpent spear over four meters long, he was deemed worth ten thousand men.
battleCry:
I'm Zhang Fei!
Anyone who wants to die, come at me!
victoryCryDuel: That's the true strength of Zhang Fei!
victoryCryBattle: I'm Zhang Fei! Do you lot want to die?!

skill.name: Power Tactics
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW.

name: Zhao Lei
lore: Guan Yu's commander in Jing Province. When Lu Meng's Wu army took it, he was trapped at Maicheng with Guan Yu and his son. To fool the enemy he lined the walls with banners and dummies, then tried a desperate breakout with a few dozen riders.
battleCry: A retainer's duty is to give his best at all times!
victoryCryBattle: This land is ours. Withdraw.

skill.name: Wheel Tutor
skill.description: Raises the POW of the Spear ally with the highest POW on the field, other than this Unit, and its spear Thrust hits in all directions. This Unit dies on activation.
skill.shortDescription:
Strongest Spear ally gains POW and
all-round Thrust; this Unit dies

name: Ma Su
lore: A Shu general immortalized in the saying 'to weep as you execute Ma Su.' Though Zhuge Liang's disciple, he was overconfident. At Jieting, he ignored orders and camped on a hilltop, leading to defeat. Zhuge Liang tearfully had him executed.
battleCry:
Not even the Chancellor
could understand my strategy.
victoryCryDuel: You had no chance against me.
victoryCryBattle: It paid to ignore orders and attack!

skill.name: Provoke
skill.description: Makes every enemy in range move toward this Unit.

name: Ma Dai
lore: Ma Chao's cousin, plain and diligent, unlike his flashy kinsman. Zhuge Liang's dying order: 'Serve quietly as Wei Yan's deputy.' When Wei Yan rebelled as foreseen and cried, 'Who can slay me?', Ma Dai cut him down at once, ending the revolt.
battleCry:
Wei Yan!
The one to slay you is right here!
victoryCryDuel: I'm right heeere!
victoryCryBattle: I nipped that rebellion in the bud.

skill.name: Speed Tactics
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW and SPD.

name: Ma Chao
lore: One of Shu's Five Tiger Generals. From youth, he fought alongside his father Ma Teng in many battles. After rebelling against Cao Cao and losing, he joined Liu Bei. He served with distinction in the Shu campaign and at Hanzhong.
battleCry:
Before Ma Chao the Splendid,
any foe becomes a corpse!
victoryCryDuel: It seems my valor has surpassed yours.
victoryCryBattle: Raise the banner! Victory is ours!

skill.name: Silver Lion
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW, SPD and Charge damage.
skill.shortDescription: Raises POW, SPD and Charge damage

name: Ma Chao
lore: One of Shu's Five Tiger Generals, a western hero who slew an enemy commander at 17, called 'Ma Chao the Splendid.' He rose against Cao Cao and lost. In exile he fought Zhang Fei to a draw, then was won over by Liu Bei and excelled at Hanzhong.
battleCry:
Will you come? With sword in hand,
there is nothing I cannot cut!
victoryCryDuel: No one can stop the flash of my spear.
victoryCryBattle: Did you see that? Such is my power!

skill.name: 1000-Man Slayer
skill.description: Greatly raises this Unit's POW, and enemy Skills can no longer target it.
skill.shortDescription:
Greatly raises POW
Enemy Skills can't target it

name: Ma Liang
lore: Ma Su's elder brother, said to be the finest of five gifted brothers. His white eyebrows gave rise to the saying 'White Brows is the best.' He served as envoy to Sun Quan of Wu and won over foreign tribes, aiding Liu Bei in many ways.
battleCry: Please, leave this to White Brows.
victoryCryBattle: Leave it to White Brows.

skill.name: Line Revival
skill.description: Revives one of your dead Units, chosen at random if two or more are dead. It reappears where it died, but a Unit that died in the enemy's half reappears in your own half.

name: Lady Mi
lore: Liu Bei's wife and Mi Zhu's sister, wise and close to his first wife, Lady Gan. At Changban she fled with Lady Gan's son A Dou but hurt her leg. Fearing to be a burden, she gave A Dou to Zhao Yun when he came, and threw herself into a well.
battleCry:
Lord Zhao Yun, please,
I leave this child to you...!
victoryCryDuel: I'm so glad I wasn't a burden to you...
victoryCryBattle: May the world know peace someday...

skill.name: Field Dance
skill.description: [Dance] (Once used, this Unit can't move, but the effect lasts until it dies.) Whenever a Unit dies, on either side, its own side's Castle takes damage.
skill.shortDescription:
[Dance] Every Unit that dies, on
either side, damages its own Castle

name: Fa Zheng
lore: A Shu strategist. With Zhang Song, he urged Liu Bei to take Yi Province. At Mount Dingjun, he and Huang Zhong outmaneuvered Xiahou Yuan, securing Hanzhong. But he also abused his power to take petty revenge, a dark side to his nature.
battleCry:
Heh heh heh...
All according to plan. Attack!
victoryCryBattle: You reveal your hand only at the very end.

skill.name: Wheel Command
skill.description: Raises the POW of allies in range, and the spear Thrust of Spear Units among them hits in all directions.
skill.shortDescription:
Raises ally POW; Spear Units
Thrust in all directions

name: Pang Tong
lore: The Fledgling Phoenix, one of two great strategists with Zhuge Liang. His cunning won battle after battle as Liu Bei took Shu. But at Falling Phoenix Slope, having swapped horses with Liu Bei, he was taken for him and shot down by ambushers.
battleCry:
Falling Phoenix Slope...
What an ominous name.
victoryCryBattle: Looks like the phoenix chick is ready to fly.

skill.name: Chain Ploy+
skill.description: Lowers the SPD of enemies in range.

name: Meng Da
lore: A defiant general famed less for valor than for his many betrayals. He betrayed Liu Zhang to help Liu Bei take Shu, then defected to Wei. When he plotted to rebel against Wei too, Sima Yi saw through him, and he fell in battle.
battleCry:
It seems the next wind
is blowing my way.
victoryCryDuel: You should have betrayed them too...
victoryCryBattle: I am the true victor here!

skill.name: Rebel Signal
skill.description: Greatly raises this Unit's POW. On activation, one of your other Units on the field dies. If there is no other Unit to die, the effect is weaker.
skill.shortDescription:
Greatly raises POW
but 1 other ally dies

name: Liu Bei
lore: The hero of the Three Kingdoms. His rare charisma drew warriors and sages to him, Guan Yu and Zhang Fei first, as he fought to restore the Han. After roaming the battlefields of an age of warlords, he took Shu and became Emperor of Shu Han.
battleCry:
Come with me.
Let's use your strength for the realm.
victoryCryDuel: How about it? Why not come along with me?
victoryCryBattle: I'm gonna bring the Han dynasty back!

skill.name: Liu Bei Virtue
skill.description: Raises the POW of all Shu allies in range.

name: Liu Bei
lore: The hero of the Three Kingdoms, risen from the volunteer militia. While seeking to fight the Yellow Turbans, Liu Bei met Zhang Fei and Guan Yu. The three swore brotherhood in the Peach Garden, beginning their fight for the realm.
battleCry:
We swear to Heaven!
Though born on different days,
may we die on the same day and hour!
victoryCryDuel: I cannot allow myself to lose.
victoryCryBattle: Now you know the power of virtue!

skill.name: Peach Oath
skill.description: Greatly raises the POW of allies in range. But if even one of them dies, every ally under the effect dies too.
skill.shortDescription:
Greatly raises ally POW, but if one
dies, all the affected allies die

name: Liu Feng
lore: Liu Bei's adopted son. Facing Meng Da, who had betrayed Shu for Wei, he was urged: 'Liu Bei will kill you to make way for his own son. Join Wei while you can!' Liu Feng firmly refused, proving his trust in and loyalty to Liu Bei.
battleCry:
My adoptive father
is not such a petty man!
victoryCryDuel: See? Even I can do it if I try!
victoryCryBattle: Father! I did it!

skill.name: Power Tactics
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW.

name: Liao Hua
lore: Once a Yellow Turban remnant. He joined Guan Yu during the Five Passes escape and served as his right hand. After Guan Yu's death, he often led the vanguard. He lived long, fighting from the Yellow Turban era to Shu's fall.
battleCry:
An ordinary general like me
can only keep fighting!
victoryCryDuel: I haven't fought for decades for nothing!
victoryCryBattle: No longer just an ordinary general!

skill.name: Fury Tactics
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW and restores its HP.

name: Kan Ze
lore: A Wu strategist, a poor farmer's son whose wisdom caught Sun Quan's eye. At Red Cliffs, in Zhou Yu and Huang Gai's Self-Torture Scheme, he took the false surrender to Cao Cao, who saw through it; Kan Ze talked him round and led Wu to victory.
battleCry:
My plan will not waver.
I shall see it through.
victoryCryBattle: My plan worked perfectly.

skill.name: Risk Recommend
skill.description: Raises the INT of the ally with the highest POW on the field. But this Unit dies on activation.
skill.shortDescription:
Strongest ally gains INT
This Unit then dies

name: Han Dang
lore: A Wu general and master of the glaive. He served three generations of the Sun family. Strict with discipline yet inspirational, his troops were always in high spirits and united. Until illness took him, he devoted himself to Wu's prosperity.
battleCry:
Each and every one of you
carries this nation. Never forget it!
victoryCryDuel: This is why I love the battlefield!
victoryCryBattle: Too bad, it's over already.

skill.name: Power Tactics
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW.

name: Gan Ning
lore: A bold and cunning Wu general. He urged Sun Quan to attack his former master Huang Zu, then led the army that slew him. At Ruxu, he raided Cao Cao's camp with just 100 men, throwing the enemy into chaos and winning a stunning victory.
battleCry:
Oh, another battle?
Time for me to shine!
victoryCryDuel: And you call yourself a general?!
victoryCryBattle: Over already? I'm still itching for a fight!

skill.name: River Pirate
skill.description: Reduces the POW-based damage that allies in range take.

name: Gan Ning
lore: A fierce Wu general. Rough by nature, in youth he lived as a lawless outlaw, until books reformed him and he served Liu Biao and Huang Zu. Neither valued him, so he joined Sun Quan, killed Huang Zu, and shone through daring and quick wits.
battleCry:
You're dead, pal.
The name's Gan Ning of Wu!
victoryCryDuel: Gyahaha! Thought you could take me on?!
victoryCryBattle: Alright, where's the next battle?!

skill.name: Wu Valor
skill.description: [Focus] (Takes effect a set time after the Skill button is pressed. Can't be Denied.) Raises this Unit's POW.

name: Yu Fan
lore: A Wu official known for speaking his mind. He served as envoy in the war against Guan Yu and was a master diviner who predicted Guan Yu's death. But his arrogance grated on Sun Quan, who eventually demoted him.
battleCry:
Fool!
Cowering like a bird in a cage,
how can you speak out for your lord?
victoryCryBattle: Fool. Did you think you could hold out?

skill.name: Wu Flames
skill.description: [Focus] (Takes effect a set time after the Skill button is pressed. Can't be Denied.) Deals fire damage to enemies in range. The damage depends on this Unit's INT against the target's.

name: Huang Gai
lore: A veteran since Sun Jian's day. At Red Cliffs he proposed the Self-Torture Scheme, a feigned surrender to strike deep into the enemy, and took the role himself. His fireships rammed Cao Cao's fleet, burning his army and leading Wu to victory.
battleCry:
If this old life of mine can win
this war, it is a cheap price!
victoryCryDuel: I can't throw my life away until we win!
victoryCryBattle: You let me through. You lose!

skill.name: Siege to Death
skill.description: Deals damage to the enemy Castle. Usable only while this Unit's Siege Gauge is showing. This Unit dies on activation.
skill.shortDescription:
Damages the enemy Castle
This Unit then dies

name: Lady Wu
lore: Sun Jian's wife, posthumously Empress Wulie. Of the noble Wu clan, she ran politics for her warrior husband and shielded him from local clans, a model wife. After his death she guarded her young sons Sun Ce and Sun Quan until they came of age.
battleCry:
Pull yourself together!
Save your crying for after you win.
victoryCryDuel: You did well, too.
victoryCryBattle: Now, don't you settle for this little!

skill.name: Rally Dance
skill.description: [Dance] (Once used, this Unit can't move, but the effect lasts until it dies.) Your MP fills faster.

name: Zhou Tai
lore: A warrior who rose through merit under Sun Ce. Close in age to Sun Quan, he served as bodyguard. When bandits attacked at Xuancheng, he defended his lord despite wounds. The countless scars across his body became a warrior's badge of honor.
battleCry:
These hundred scars...
every single one is my pride!
victoryCryDuel: I'll remember this wound.
victoryCryBattle: One more scar to add to the count, then.

skill.name: Han Pride
skill.description: Greatly raises this Unit's POW. But it dies when the effect ends.
skill.shortDescription:
Greatly raises POW
This Unit dies when it ends

name: Zhou Yu
lore: A young genius who led Wu's armies after Sun Ce's death. He opened the Battle of Red Cliffs, burning Cao Cao's navy of hundreds of thousands. His Plan to Divide the Realm in Two, taking Shu to corner Cao Cao, was near success when he fell ill.
battleCry:
Though this body may wither,
I will carry Wu's banner across the realm!
victoryCryDuel: You did well, until you came after me.
victoryCryBattle: My life's flame will not burn out!

skill.name: Chibi Inferno
skill.description: Deals fire damage to enemies in range. The damage depends on this Unit's INT against the target's.

name: Zhu Huan
lore: A Wu general of a powerful clan, better at strategy than arms. He knew by heart the wives and children of his ten thousand men. Facing Cao Ren's tens of thousands with 5,000, he made his castle look deserted, then struck: the Empty Fort ploy.
battleCry:
Victory isn't won by numbers,
but by a commander's skill!
victoryCryDuel: Amateur. Your moves are predictable.
victoryCryBattle: A commander's skill is what decides victory!

skill.name: Fire Ploy
skill.description: Deals fire damage to enemies in range. The damage depends on this Unit's INT against the target's.

name: Zhu Zhi
lore: A veteran who served Wu from Sun Jian to Sun Quan. Modest and sincere, he stood by young Sun Ce when others left after Sun Jian died, and advised trading the Imperial Seal to Yuan Shu for troops. He later upheld Sun Quan and guarded Wu well.
battleCry:
I'll support you, young lord,
until you take the realm!
victoryCryDuel: Whew, managed to avoid defeat.
victoryCryBattle: I'm honored one such as I could be of use.

skill.name: Wu Prayer
skill.description: [Focus] (Takes effect a set time after the Skill button is pressed. Can't be Denied.) Restores the HP of allies in range.

name: Xiao Qiao
lore: The younger of the 'Two Flowers of Jiangdong.' She married Zhou Yu, who would become Wu's pillar. The meeting of the dashing Zhou Yu and the peerless Xiao Qiao became the stuff of legend.
battleCry:
Lord Zhou Yu, please
protect our kingdom...!
victoryCryDuel: My prayers were answered!
victoryCryBattle: Hee hee, isn't that wonderful?

skill.name: Meteor Ritual
skill.description: [Focus] (Takes effect a set time after the Skill button is pressed. Can't be Denied.) Deals damage to the enemy Castle.

name: Jiang Qin
lore: An aide to Sun Ce from his days under Yuan Shu. Serving Sun Quan, he won great merit guarding his lord in flight from Wei's Zhang Liao. He recommended Xu Sheng, who had once punished one of his men, never mixing personal with public.
battleCry:
Out of my way, you fools!
Move it!
victoryCryDuel: Don't mess with me, punk!
victoryCryBattle: Get outta my way, all of you!

skill.name: Weaken Bow
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW, and its arrows lower the POW of the enemies they hit.
skill.shortDescription:
Raises POW
Its arrows lower enemy POW

name: Zhuge Jin
lore: Zhuge Liang's elder brother. He served Sun Quan and enjoyed his full trust: an all-round official, among Wu's best, skilled in government, diplomacy and war. Fair and upright, he never met his brother privately when Zhuge Liang came to Wu.
battleCry:
As you trust me, Sir,
so I shall trust you.
victoryCryBattle: Glad I could live up to your hopes, Sir.

skill.name: Swift Retreat
skill.description: Instantly returns allies in range to your Castle.

name: Xu Sheng
lore: A general under Sun Quan. When Cao Cao invaded Ruxu, a storm grounded Wu's ships on enemy shores. While others feared to disembark, Xu Sheng's troops boldly charged into the enemy camp and routed Wei's forces.
battleCry:
Fair warning:
I show no mercy to losers!
victoryCryDuel: No mercy for losers!
victoryCryBattle: Ha! You walked right into my trap!

skill.name: Summon Support
skill.description: [Summon] (Summons allied Units that follow a set pattern. Only one kind of Summon Skill can be active at a time.) Summons 2 Support soldiers.

name: Zu Mao
lore: An officer under Sun Jian. When the fierce Hua Xiong pursued Sun Jian in the war against Dong Zhuo, Zu Mao wore his lord's red headscarf as a decoy. Sun Jian escaped, but Zu Mao was killed, to his lord's grief. He was said to wield two swords.
battleCry:
I'll carve open the path
for you, Sir!
victoryCryDuel: Sir, I have carved open the path!
victoryCryBattle: Sir, victory is ours!

skill.name: Summon Decoy
skill.description: [Summon] (Summons allied Units that follow a set pattern. Only one kind of Summon Skill can be active at a time.) Summons a Decoy.

name: Sun Huan
lore: A Wu general. During Liu Bei's invasion, he defended Wu alongside Lu Xun. Surrounded by Shu's overwhelming force, Sun Huan fought fearlessly and repelled them. He then cut off Liu Bei's retreat routes, nearly capturing him.
battleCry:
The terror of having no retreat...
now you shall taste it too.
victoryCryDuel: To break an army, this is the best way.
victoryCryBattle: Sure victory. That is how war should be fought!

skill.name: Fire Ploy
skill.description: Deals fire damage to enemies in range. The damage depends on this Unit's INT against the target's.

name: Sun Jian
lore: Father of Sun Ce and Sun Quan. He led the vanguard of the lords against Dong Zhuo, who fled the capital fearing him. There Sun Jian found the Imperial Seal in a well, sure he was meant to rule, but a stray arrow killed him fighting Huang Zu.
battleCry:
Forward, men!
The Mandate of Heaven is mine!
victoryCryDuel: Have you never heard of Sun Jian?
victoryCryBattle: Forward, men! The Mandate of Heaven is mine!

skill.name: Divine Vision
skill.description: Greatly raises the POW of allies in range. But when the effect ends, the affected Units die.
skill.shortDescription:
Greatly raises ally POW
They die when it ends

name: Sun Quan
lore: Lord of Wu, Sun Jian's second son and Sun Ce's younger brother, who took up Sun Ce's cause while young. Generous and decisive, he governed Jiangdong skillfully. At Red Cliffs he staked his nation's fate on war, rallied his men, and won.
battleCry:
Cao Cao! You took me for a mere boy,
and that is why you lost!
victoryCryDuel: I got carried away. It runs in the blood.
victoryCryBattle: The battle is ours! Raise Wu's banner high!

skill.name: Young King Art
skill.description: Raises the POW of all Wu allies in range.

name: Sun Ce
lore: Sun Jian's eldest son, Sun Quan's elder brother, the Little Conqueror. A genius in war, he subdued the south while young, laying Wu's foundations. Set to march on the Central Plains, he paid for his rashness with an assassin's poisoned arrow.
battleCry:
Heaven! Would you have me
die in a place like this!?
victoryCryDuel: Well fought! But you fell short of me.
victoryCryBattle: Don't dawdle! On to the next battle!

skill.name: Conqueror Fury
skill.description: Greatly raises this Unit's POW and SPD. But it dies when the effect ends.
skill.shortDescription:
Greatly raises POW and SPD
This Unit dies when it ends

name: Sun Ce
lore: Sun Jian's eldest son. After his father died he rose with a few of Yuan Shu's troops and swept all before him with his sworn brother Zhou Yu. Brave and charismatic, he was hailed as Jiangdong's Little Conqueror, after Xiang Yu the Conqueror.
battleCry:
Stand aside!
Once I'm fired up, I show no mercy!
victoryCryDuel: Don't throw your life away, you idiot!
victoryCryBattle: None but me can stop my war!

skill.name: Soaring Time
skill.description: [Focus] (Takes effect a set time after the Skill button is pressed. Can't be Denied.) Greatly raises this Unit's POW and raises its SPD.

name: Sun Ren
lore: Liu Bei's wife and Sun Quan's sister, wed to him in a political match. Bolder than most men and skilled at arms, she kept maids armed with glaives always waiting in her chambers. Liu Bei, it is said, was a bundle of nerves around her.
battleCry:
Come on!
Aren't you supposed to be the realm's great hero?
Straighten up, I say, straighten up!
victoryCryDuel: I do train, you know!
victoryCryBattle: I won't lose that easily!

skill.name: Fury Tactics
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW and restores its HP.

name: Da Qiao
lore: The elder of the 'Two Flowers of Jiangdong,' as peerless a beauty as her sister. Cao Cao of Wei, once a friend of their father Lord Qiao, longed to have both sisters, but Da Qiao married Sun Ce, the hero of Wu.
battleCry:
Lord Sun Ce,
I await your return...
victoryCryDuel: If only we hadn't met...
victoryCryBattle: The sky is beautiful today...

skill.name: Grand Meteor
skill.description: [Focus] (Takes effect a set time after the Skill button is pressed. Can't be Denied.) Deals damage to the enemy Castle.

name: Taishi Ci
lore: A Wu general who clashed fiercely with Sun Ce, then joined him in admiration. The trust born in battle ran deep: famously, once freed he could have fled, yet he rallied the beaten troops and came back to Sun Ce. He then fought at the front.
battleCry:
Lord Sun Ce!
My life is in your hands, all of it!
victoryCryDuel: Told you I'm fast.
victoryCryBattle: Now rot where you fell!

skill.name: Promise Troops
skill.description: [Summon] (Summons allied Units that follow a set pattern. Only one kind of Summon Skill can be active at a time.) Summons a Support soldier.

name: Taishi Ci
lore: A Wu general who clashed with Sun Ce as a foe, then swore loyalty to him. Known as a master archer who never missed. He continued as one of Wu's finest after Sun Ce's death, until he fell at the Battle of Hefei.
battleCry:
Those who have never known a true battlefield
have no hope of beating me.
victoryCryDuel: Pointless. You could never beat me.
victoryCryBattle: This castle should make a fine souvenir.

skill.name: Paralyze Arrow
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW and bow range, and its arrows lower the SPD of the enemies they hit.
skill.shortDescription:
Raises POW and range
Its arrows lower enemy SPD

name: Zhang Hong
lore: A Wu sage invited by Sun Ce, one of the 'Two Zhangs' with Zhang Zhao. On a mission to Cao Cao when Sun Ce suddenly died, he talked Cao Cao out of exploiting it to attack Wu, appealing to honor. Back in Wu, his many proposals aided Sun Quan.
battleCry:
A king's way is to grant favors,
not nurse grudges.
victoryCryBattle: I shall guide you onto the kingly way, Sir.

skill.name: Purify Ploy
skill.description: Removes the effects of enemy Skills from allies in range.
skill.shortDescription: Clears enemy Skill effects from allies

name: Zhang Zhao
lore: One of the 'Two Zhangs' alongside Zhang Hong. He answered Sun Ce's invitation. After Sun Ce's death, he followed his dying wish to support Sun Quan. Stubborn, he clashed often with his lord; when ignored, he refused to leave his house.
battleCry:
Honestly, Sir, you give me
nothing but trouble!
victoryCryBattle: Honestly, what a handful you are...

skill.name: Rebuild Fence
skill.description: Rebuilds one of your broken fences.

name: Chen Wu
lore: A general with an eerie yellow face and red eyes. A veteran who fought across many battlefields since Sun Ce's time. He led the fourth fleet at Red Cliffs. Later, in a clash with Pang De, he was cornered in the brush and slain.
battleCry:
Me... fight hard...
crush enemy... for Sir...
victoryCryDuel: Me... fight hard!
victoryCryBattle: Me... do good!

skill.name: Han Pride
skill.description: Greatly raises this Unit's POW. But it dies when the effect ends.
skill.shortDescription:
Greatly raises POW
This Unit dies when it ends

name: Cheng Pu
lore: A veteran who served three generations of the Sun family. Wu's eldest general, he was called 'Elder Cheng.' At Red Cliffs he was Zhou Yu's deputy. Resentful at first, he was won over by Zhou Yu's strategy, and they grew to trust each other.
battleCry:
Charge!
Now we take Cao Cao's head!
victoryCryDuel: That was hardly even a warm-up.
victoryCryBattle: This is true strength.

skill.name: Far Bow
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW and bow range.

name: Ding Feng
lore: He honed his skills under talents like Gan Ning, Lu Xun, and Pan Zhang. He fought at Red Cliffs, Jing Province, and Yiling, earning many honors. When Wei invaded after Sun Quan's death, he routed 100,000 with just 3,000 men.
battleCry:
I am a general.
I will not fight a shameful battle!
victoryCryDuel: A general won't fall to rabble!
victoryCryBattle: This much is expected of a general.

skill.name: Paralyze Arrow
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW and bow range, and its arrows lower the SPD of the enemies they hit.
skill.shortDescription:
Raises POW and range
Its arrows lower enemy SPD

name: Dong Xi
lore: A Wu general, brave, daring and deeply loyal. Against Huang Zu he slipped through a rain of arrows to win the day. At Hefei, covering Sun Quan's escape, he stayed on his sinking ship to the very end and died there.
battleCry:
I'll protect my lord's life
with my last breath!
victoryCryDuel: I won't lose so easily!
victoryCryBattle: Sometimes offense is the best defense.

skill.name: Guard Tactics
skill.description: Reduces the POW-based damage this Unit takes.

name: Pan Zhang
lore: A brave general under Sun Quan. In the conquest of Jing Province, following Lu Meng's plan, he captured Guan Yu and his son Guan Ping, and took Guan Yu's famed Green Dragon Blade. At Yiling, Guan Xing knew him by it and cut him down.
battleCry:
Lord Guan Yu, this legendary blade...
I'll be taking it!
victoryCryDuel: So this is the Green Dragon Blade's edge!
victoryCryBattle: Hahaha! What incredible power!

skill.name: Power Tactics
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW.

name: Lu Kang
lore: Lu Xun's son. At 20, after his father's death, he commanded 5,000 troops. Modest and trusted, he and Jin's Yang Hu respected each other as foes, exchanging gifts of wine and medicine. Their border remained peaceful.
battleCry:
Though we may be enemies,
we can surely be friends.
victoryCryDuel: Have I come a bit closer to Father now?
victoryCryBattle: I fought a battle worthy of Father's name.

skill.name: Skirmish Lead
skill.description: Raises the POW of allies in range.

name: Lu Xun
lore: A young strategist of letters and arms who saved Wu. When Liu Bei attacked at Yiling to avenge Guan Yu, Lu Xun, made Grand Commander, burned and crushed his army, then drove off Wei's opportunistic attack. Wei and Shu found no opening again.
battleCry:
Endure the crisis,
and victory will reveal itself.
victoryCryDuel: I will never forget a commander like you.
victoryCryBattle: As long as I'm here, we won't lose!

skill.name: Sun Tzu Order
skill.description: [Focus] (Takes effect a set time after the Skill button is pressed. Can't be Denied.) Raises the POW of all Wu allies in range.

name: Ling Cao
lore: A fierce general under Sun Ce and Ling Tong's father. Always at the vanguard. When attacking Huang Zu, he fell to an arrow from Gan Ning, then in Huang Zu's service. This created a lasting feud between Ling Tong and Gan Ning.
battleCry:
A veteran's might...
I'll carve it into you!
victoryCryDuel: Not bad, but still too green!
victoryCryBattle: Now, on to the next battlefield!!

skill.name: Power Tactics
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW.

name: Ling Tong
lore: At 15, he braved the battlefield to retrieve his father's remains. He defended Sun Quan from Zhang Liao at Hefei. When enemies destroyed the bridge, he fought until Sun Quan crossed, then dove into the river to survive.
battleCry:
Drop your weapons
if you wanna live!
victoryCryDuel: Don't you ever raise a blade to me again!
victoryCryBattle: Drop your weapons if you wanna live!

skill.name: Wu Valor
skill.description: [Focus] (Takes effect a set time after the Skill button is pressed. Can't be Denied.) Raises this Unit's POW.

name: Lu Fan
lore: A retainer from Sun Ce's youth, highly trusted. After Sun Ce died, he helped Zhou Yu and Cheng Pu support Sun Quan. He arranged the marriage between Liu Bei and Sun Ren and plotted to assassinate Liu Bei, though he failed.
battleCry:
This way, Lord Liu Bei.
Right this way.
victoryCryBattle: All those years of support were worth it.

skill.name: Weaken Bow
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW, and its arrows lower the POW of the enemies they hit.
skill.shortDescription:
Raises POW
Its arrows lower enemy POW

name: Lu Meng
lore: One of Wu's greatest strategists. After Lu Su's death, he led the campaign to take Jing Province. Feigning illness, he swapped with the unknown Lu Xun to lull Guan Yu. Then he turned Fu Shiren and Mi Fang, isolating and capturing Guan Yu.
battleCry:
Guan Yu's destiny is at an end.
Take him down!
victoryCryDuel: You let your guard down, fool!
victoryCryBattle: Seems you got careless.

skill.name: Paralyze Order
skill.description: Raises the POW of allies in range. Bow Units among them also lower the SPD of the enemies their arrows hit.
skill.shortDescription:
Raises ally POW; Bow Units' arrows
lower enemy SPD

name: Lu Su
lore: A famed Wu strategist, born to wealth, who sought out wise men. Recommended by Zhou Yu, he offered Sun Quan the bold Plan to Divide the Realm in Two. To counter Cao Cao he urged an alliance with Liu Bei and, as envoy, forged the Wu-Shu pact.
battleCry:
So that's how it is.
I humbly ask for your cooperation.
victoryCryBattle: Well, that went rather nicely.

skill.name: Summon Charger
skill.description: [Summon] (Summons allied Units that follow a set pattern. Only one kind of Summon Skill can be active at a time.) Summons a Charger.

name: Yu Ji
lore: A Taoist sage revered by the people, seized by Sun Ce as one who led hearts astray. Promised a pardon if he brought rain, he did so, but was executed anyway. His ghost then appeared and cursed Sun Ce to death.
battleCry:
Fo fo fo...
Receive my curse!
victoryCryBattle: Fo fo fo... I'll take this win, thank you.

skill.name: Water Bane
skill.description: Deals water damage to enemies in range. The damage depends on this Unit's INT against the target's.

name: Yuan Shu
lore: Yuan Shao's brother. Heir to the Yuan clan, he won fame and a vast army, but lost support by taking the Imperial Seal from Sun Ce and naming himself emperor. Beaten by Liu Bei, he died fleeing to Yuan Shao, spitting blood, moaning for honey.
battleCry:
Hee hee hee... I am the emperor.
I really am the emperor...
victoryCryBattle: Everyone! Celebrate your emperor's victory!

skill.name: Self-Destruct
skill.description: Deals fire damage to enemies in range. The damage depends on this Unit's INT against the target's. This Unit dies afterwards.
skill.shortDescription:
Deals fire damage
This Unit then dies

name: Jia Xu
lore: A strategist under Dong Zhuo. When Lu Bu killed Dong Zhuo, he united Dong Zhuo's men and drove Lu Bu from Changan. Feared by Li Jue and others, he fled and became Zhang Xiu's strategist, bringing Cao Cao to the brink with bold schemes.
battleCry: Heh... my plans never fail.
victoryCryBattle: I am not one to make a blunder.

skill.name: Death Ploy
skill.description: Lowers the POW of enemies in range. An enemy that dies while the effect lasts takes longer to Revive.
skill.shortDescription:
Lowers enemy POW; if one dies,
it takes longer to Revive

name: Hua Xiong
lore: Dong Zhuo's foremost general. Nine feet tall with a fearsome visage: tiger body, wolf waist, leopard head. As vanguard, he smashed the Coalition, slaying champion after champion and throwing the allied lords into panic.
battleCry:
CRY AND BEG FOR MERCY,
DOGS OF THE HAN THRONE!
victoryCryDuel: INSECTS! RETURN TO THE DIRT!
victoryCryBattle: CRY AND BEG FOR MERCY, YOU BEATEN DOGS!

skill.name: Demon Blade
skill.description: Greatly raises this Unit's POW. But your Castle takes damage while the effect lasts.
skill.shortDescription:
Greatly raises POW
but your Castle takes damage

name: Ji Ling
lore: A general under Yuan Shu. Against Liu Bei's army, he clashed with Guan Yu and held him to a 30-bout draw, such was his prowess. But while escorting Yuan Shu in flight to Yuan Shao, he was ambushed by Liu Bei and cut down by Zhang Fei.
battleCry:
I am Ji Ling,
Yuan Shu's foremost general!
victoryCryDuel: Pity. I wanted that strength in my army.
victoryCryBattle: I'll spare your life. Throw down your arms!

skill.name: Mass Assault
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW. The more allied Units on the field, the bigger the increase.
skill.shortDescription:
Raises POW
More allies on the field, more POW

name: Yan
lore: Lu Bu's wife. When Cao Cao besieged Xiapi, Chen Gong urged Lu Bu to ride out and strike from behind, but Lady Yan refused to be left in a castle held by Chen Gong, so he gave it up. After his execution she was sent to Xuchang with his family.
battleCry:
Hold on, Fengxian!
You're leaving me behind?
victoryCryDuel: My, you were rather good, dear.
victoryCryBattle: Ufufu, I'll be taking this.

skill.name: Ruin Dance
skill.description: [Dance] (Once used, this Unit can't move, but the effect lasts until it dies.) Keeps damaging both your Castle and the enemy Castle.

name: Gao Shun
lore: Lu Bu's chief general once Lu Bu went independent. He led the elite 'Camp Crushers', who never failed to take an enemy position, terrifying his foes. He beat Liu Bei and Xiahou Dun in turn, but refused to surrender and shared Lu Bu's fate.
battleCry:
Death to the weak!
None can stop my charge!
victoryCryDuel: Death to the weak.
victoryCryBattle: And that is why we are called the Siege Camp!

skill.name: Siege Camp
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW, Siege power and damage to fences. The lower your Castle HP, the bigger the POW increase.
skill.shortDescription:
Raises POW, Siege and fence damage
More POW the lower your Castle HP

name: Gongsun Zan
lore: Governor of Beiping. A fellow student with Liu Bei, he once sheltered him. He earned fame as the 'White Horse General' crushing northern tribes with his cavalry. He fought Yuan Shao for northern dominance but lost and took his own life.
battleCry:
Heh heh heh, Yuan Shao!
You are helpless against my White Horse formation!
victoryCryDuel: Heh heh heh, I'm the White Horse General!
victoryCryBattle: Before my White Horse riders, you're babes!

skill.name: White Horse
skill.description: Raises the SPD of all allies in range.

name: Hu Cheer
lore: Zhang Xiu's bravest officer. When Zhang Xiu launched a surprise attack on Cao Cao, he stole the iron halberds of Cao Cao's guard Dian Wei, who was killed in the fight. Hugely strong, he could reportedly carry 500 jin and walk 700 li in a day.
battleCry:
This Hu Cheer...
never lets his prey escape!
victoryCryDuel: My prey never escapes...
victoryCryBattle: And that's how it's done.

skill.name: Death Tactics
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW. Enemies it defeats while the effect lasts take longer to Revive.
skill.shortDescription:
Raises POW; enemies it defeats
take longer to Revive

name: Zuo Ci
lore: A mysterious hermit who told Cao Cao to yield to Liu Bei, enraging him. Cao Cao hunted him but caught hundreds with the same face. When all were executed, smoke rose and Zuo Ci appeared on a crane, prophesied Cao Cao's death, and vanished.
battleCry:
Foolish King of Wei!
Learn the will of Heaven!
victoryCryBattle: Fools! That's what comes of ignoring me!

skill.name: Transform Art
skill.description: This Unit's POW becomes equal to that of the enemy Lord with the highest POW, including any increases from Skills and other effects.
skill.shortDescription: POW matches the strongest enemy Lord

name: Lady Zou
lore: Wife of Zhang Ji, uncle of Zhang Xiu. A rare beauty, she enthralled Cao Cao when he came to subdue Zhang Xiu. While he was lost in her, Zhang Xiu attacked. Cao Cao barely escaped with his life, but lost his son and many able retainers.
battleCry:
Even the greatest hero
is just a man before me...
victoryCryDuel: Skill like that? I can't fall for you.
victoryCryBattle: If you want me, you'll have to grow stronger.

skill.name: Bitter Dance
skill.description: [Dance] (Once used, this Unit can't move, but the effect lasts until it dies.) Each time an ally dies, your allies' POW rises for a set time.
skill.shortDescription:
[Dance] Each time an ally dies,
ally POW rises for a while

name: Zhang Jiao
lore: Founder of the Taiping faith, which shook all China. With the Taiping Art from the Nanhua immortal he wielded inhuman power. As General of Heaven he led millions of Yellow Turbans against the court. Crushed in months, it began the Han's fall.
battleCry:
The Azure Heaven is dead!
The Yellow Heaven shall rise!
victoryCryDuel: I am Heaven's will. You cannot prevail.
victoryCryBattle: Yellow Turbans! Seek the age of Great Peace!

skill.name: YT Rebellion
skill.description: Revives all of your dead Units and raises their POW. But this Unit dies on activation.
skill.shortDescription:
Revives all dead allies, raises POW
This Unit then dies

name: Zhang Xun
lore: Yuan Shu's Grand General. When Yuan Shu attacked Lu Bu for breaking off a marriage pact, Zhang Xun was given 200,000 men. But allies duped by Chen Gui betrayed him, and Lu Bu crushed him. After Yuan Shu died, he submitted to Cao Cao.
battleCry:
You dare lecture me, the Grand General?
Come back in ten years!
victoryCryDuel: I'm the Grand General! The esteemed one!
victoryCryBattle: I'm the Grand General! The glorious one!

skill.name: Mass Produce
skill.description: Revives all of your dead Rams and raises their SPD.
skill.shortDescription: Revives all Rams and raises their SPD

name: Zhang Xiu
lore: A Dong Zhuo officer who went independent after his death and fought Cao Cao. He surrendered, but rebelled when Cao Cao made his uncle Zhang Ji's widow, Lady Zou, a concubine. On Jia Xu's advice he later submitted again, as Cao Cao's general.
battleCry:
Now's our chance!
Hunt Cao Cao down!
victoryCryDuel: I'm on fire today!
victoryCryBattle: Nothing can stop this momentum!

skill.name: Pure Evil
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW, but your Castle takes damage while the effect lasts. The lower your Castle HP, the bigger the POW increase.
skill.shortDescription:
Raises POW
but your Castle takes damage

name: Diao Chan
lore: One of China's Four Great Beauties, with Yang Guifei and others. She became Lu Bu's concubine as part of a plot and seduced him into killing his own lord, Dong Zhuo. Men speak of a beauty who topples nations; Diao Chan truly toppled one.
battleCry:
Come, Lord Lu Bu...
Let us take everything together.
victoryCryDuel: Ascend to heaven.
victoryCryBattle: Get too close and you'll get burned.

skill.name: Ruinous Dance
skill.description: [Dance] (Once used, this Unit can't move, but the effect lasts until it dies.) Keeps damaging the enemy Castle.

name: Zhang Liao
lore: Lu Bu's general, of rare prowess. He served Ding Yuan, He Jin and Dong Zhuo before Lu Bu, and while young stood with Gao Shun as the pride of Lu Bu's army. When Lu Bu fell, he cursed Cao Cao to die with honor, but was spared and joined him.
battleCry:
My valor and horsemanship...
only Lord Lu Bu surpasses them!
victoryCryDuel: Small fry! You're not one with your horse!
victoryCryBattle: With might, I shall conquer all!

skill.name: Like Chiyou
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW and SPD. While the effect lasts, its POW keeps rising the longer it stays in Charge state.
skill.shortDescription:
Raises POW and SPD
POW grows while in Charge state

name: Zhang Liang
lore: Youngest brother of Yellow Turban leader Zhang Jiao, styled General of Man. His revolts across the land plagued the imperial army. When Zhang Jiao died of illness he took over, but the emboldened imperial army overwhelmed and slew him.
battleCry: We shall build an age of the Yellow Turbans!
victoryCryDuel: Weakling! You're no match for me!
victoryCryBattle: We shall build an age of the Yellow Turbans!

skill.name: YT Swarm
skill.description: Restores this Unit's HP.

name: Zhang Lu
lore: Founder of the Five Pecks Way, a sect named for the five pecks of rice its members gave. He made Hanzhong an independent state for 30 years. When Cao Cao came, he surrendered readily; having spared his treasury, he won Cao Cao's esteem.
battleCry: Come, eat this rice. Heh heh.
victoryCryBattle: Come now, why don't we eat some rice together?

skill.name: Five Pecks Way
skill.description: Revives one of your dead Rogue Units, chosen at random if two or more are dead. It reappears inside your Castle.

name: Chen Gong
lore: Lu Bu's strategist. He first served Cao Cao, proud to be his top advisor, but the rise of newcomers Xun Yu and Cheng Yu and the Xu Province massacre drove him to Lu Bu. Captured with Lu Bu, he was executed; Cao Cao wept for his genius.
battleCry:
Cao Cao!
I'll master these wolves and destroy you!
victoryCryBattle: With me here, victory is certain!

skill.name: Ruin Counsel
