skill.description: Raises the POW of the ally with the highest POW. But your Castle takes damage while the effect lasts.
skill.shortDescription:
Raises the strongest ally's POW
but your Castle takes damage

name: Chen Lan
lore: Yuan Shu's officer. He was Ji Ling's deputy, with Lei Bo, against Liu Bei, and led the fifth army against Lu Bu. Sick of Yuan Shu's luxury, he and Lei Bo turned bandit on Mount Song. When Liu Bei routed Yuan Shu, he looted Yuan Shu's supplies.
battleCry:
That's enough for me!
Let's just ditch Yuan Shu!
victoryCryDuel: That was plenty of fun!
victoryCryBattle: Grab anything worth stealing and let's scram!

skill.name: Lance Tactics
skill.description: Raises this Unit's SPD, but it is forced to advance while the effect lasts.
skill.shortDescription: Raises SPD but forces it to advance

name: Cheng Yuanzhi
lore: A Yellow Turban general and Liu Bei's first real opponent. Despite being one of the strongest Turbans, he was slain by a single blow from Guan Yu in a clash. Without their leader, the Turbans fell apart and lost to Liu Bei's volunteers.
battleCry:
Ragged rabble!
You'll be rust on my blade!
victoryCryDuel: Hyaaaaah!
victoryCryBattle: Nailed it!

skill.name: Power Tactics
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW.

name: Dong Zhuo
lore: The demon king who ended the Han. Installing Emperor Xian, he seized absolute power and, with brutal laws and savage punishments, slaughtered tens of thousands of innocents. Their screams pierced the heavens, and Luoyang became a living hell.
battleCry:
Four hundred years of the Han...
I shall devour them all!
victoryCryDuel: I'm not one to let those who defy me live.
victoryCryBattle: Now... roasting would be fun. Boiling, too.

skill.name: Tyrant's Path
skill.description: Raises the POW and SPD of allies in range. But your Castle takes damage while the effect lasts: the more Units affected, the more damage.
skill.shortDescription:
Raises ally POW and SPD
but your Castle takes damage

name: Dong Bai
lore: Granddaughter of Dong Zhuo, the demon king at the heart of the Han's collapse, who once in power indulged in every cruelty and luxury. As a little girl she was given her own fief by her grandfather, and grew up with all the world could offer.
battleCry:
You'll be sorry!
I'm telling Grandfather!
victoryCryDuel: Thought the likes of you could get near me?
victoryCryBattle: I'll make you all my playthings!

skill.name: Block Retreat
skill.description: Prevents enemies in range from returning to their Castle.
skill.shortDescription: Enemies can't return to their Castle

name: Pei Yuanshao
lore: Zhou Cang's partner, a Yellow Turban remnant turned bandit. He and Zhou Cang offered to serve Guan Yu, but he was left behind. Before Guan Yu returned, old habits won out: he tried to steal Zhao Yun's horse and was cut down at once. Poor man.
battleCry:
Master Guan Yu's so cold...
Ooh, nice horse!
victoryCryDuel: Whoa, I actually won!
victoryCryBattle: Hey, was that my doing?

skill.name: Power Tactics
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW.

name: Ma Yuanyi
lore: A Yellow Turban under Zhang Jiao, sent to prepare an uprising in Luoyang. But Zhang Jiao's disciple Tang Zhou betrayed them to Grand General He Jin, who had Ma Yuanyi seized and executed. Zhang Jiao, his secret out, launched the rebellion.
battleCry: I'll lay Luoyang bare.
victoryCryDuel: Heh heh heh! Not bad at all, am I?!
victoryCryBattle: Heh heh! Turns out I can do it if I try!

skill.name: Paralyze Arrow
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW, and its arrows lower the SPD of the enemies they hit.
skill.shortDescription:
Raises POW
Its arrows lower enemy SPD

name: Yang Hong
lore: Yuan Shu's secretary. When Yuan Shu planned to attack Sun Ce, he advised 'Attack Liu Bei instead; he's weaker.' When Cao Cao invaded Shouchun, he urged fleeing across the Huai rather than fighting.
battleCry:
No chance against Sun Ce, nope nope!
But Liu Bei... we might just beat him, yep!
victoryCryBattle: This victory is a big surprise, yep!

skill.name: Stealth
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW and puts it in Stealth. (Enemies can't see it, except for the moment it meets the same reveal conditions as an Ambush. Enemy Skills can still target it.)

name: Lei Bo
lore: Yuan Shu's officer, yet when Liu Bei, on Cao Cao's orders, crushed Yuan Shu, Lei Bo refused to take in the beaten army. Giving up on his lord, he turned bandit on Mount Song, and when Yuan Shu fled from Liu Bei, Lei Bo waylaid and robbed him.
battleCry:
Huff, puff... wheeze...
J-just my luck...
victoryCryDuel: I-I can't believe I won!
victoryCryBattle: Guess good things do happen once in a while...

skill.name: Lightning
skill.description: Drops 3 lightning bolts in range, each dealing lightning damage to one of the enemies there. The damage depends on this Unit's INT against the target's.

name: Li Guo
lore: Li Jue and Guo Si, Dong Zhuo's officers and childhood friends, both brutes. After Dong Zhuo died they attacked Lu Bu and drove him from Changan. Then they seized power but ruled by greed, until they fell out and faded into history's shadows.
battleCry:
Ha ha! Now the realm is mine, all mine!
And everything goes my way, mine!
victoryCryDuel: What a weakling!
victoryCryBattle: We'll suck you dry, right down to the marrow!

skill.name: Pure Evil
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW, but your Castle takes damage while the effect lasts. The lower your Castle HP, the bigger the POW increase.
skill.shortDescription:
Raises POW
but your Castle takes damage

name: Li Ru
lore: Dong Zhuo's son-in-law and strategist, cold, cruel and ruthless. When Dong Zhuo enthroned Emperor Xian, Li Ru poisoned the deposed Prince of Hongnong and his mother, Empress Dowager He, to forestall trouble. His plan let Xu Rong rout Cao Cao.
battleCry:
The prince, the dowager, Cao Cao...
Wipe out all who defy us!
victoryCryBattle: Now, tremble in fear!

skill.name: Assassin Toxin
skill.description: Poisons enemies in range, gradually lowering their HP. Entering their Castle cures the poison.
skill.shortDescription:
Poison gradually lowers enemy HP
Entering their Castle cures it

name: Lu Lingqi
lore: Lu Bu's daughter. To deepen their alliance, Lu Bu and Yuan Shu planned to wed her to Yuan Shu's son. But with Lu Bu's blood in her veins, she would never meekly say yes: she refused and ran riot, and the match turned into a war instead.
battleCry:
Being cute isn't enough
to survive an age of chaos!
victoryCryDuel: Must've been a bad dream.
victoryCryBattle: I carve my own destiny!

skill.name: Unrivaled+
skill.description: Greatly raises this Unit's POW. It also restores its HP and raises its SPD.
skill.shortDescription:
Raises POW and SPD
and restores HP

name: Lu Bu
lore: Despised as a 'wolf' for his betrayals, yet hailed as 'Flying General' for his might: the strongest warrior of the era. With his halberd, he overwhelmed Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, and Liu Bei all at once at Hulao Pass. Truly a demon god of war.
battleCry:
I have no equal.
All who face me become corpses.
victoryCryDuel: Be turned to ash!
victoryCryBattle: Fwahahaha! I have no equal!

skill.name: Unrivaled
skill.description: Greatly raises this Unit's POW. It also restores its HP and raises its SPD and INT.
skill.shortDescription:
Raises POW, SPD and INT
and restores HP

name: Jia Xu
lore: From 'Souten Kouro' by King Gonta. A cunning schemer who, serving Zhang Xiu, once drove Cao Cao to the brink of death. After joining Cao Cao, he backed him as a strategist on many battlefields.
battleCry:
The stratagems that pour
from my mind are limitless!
victoryCryBattle: Stratagems pour from my mind without limit!

skill.name: Divide Ploy
skill.description: Lowers the POW, INT and SPD of enemies in range. The effect is halved when only one Unit is affected.
skill.shortDescription:
Lowers enemy POW, INT and SPD
Halved if only 1 Unit is hit

name: Guo Jia
lore: From 'Souten Kouro' by King Gonta. Cao Cao's strategist. After helping him win against Lu Bu and at Guandu, he urged Cao Cao to cross the Great Wall and subdue the Wuhuan. A pure strategist, he thought of the next battle to his last breath.
battleCry: You people don't smell of war at all.
victoryCryBattle: You people don't smell of war at all.

skill.name: Flash Speed
skill.description: Briefly raises the POW of allies in range. Horse Units among them also gain SPD.
skill.shortDescription:
Briefly raises ally POW
Horse Units also gain SPD

name: Yue Jin
lore: From 'Souten Kouro' by King Gonta. Spotted by Cao Cao as a common soldier, he served him from then on as a general. Small but brave and bold, he never fell back, whatever enemy general or great army he faced.
battleCry: Nothing to it!
victoryCryDuel: Let's go.
victoryCryBattle: All forces, advance!

skill.name: Power Tactics
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW.

name: Xiahou Yuan
lore: From 'Souten Kouro' by King Gonta. Xiahou Dun's cousin, who also followed Cao Cao from the day he first raised troops. A master archer who excelled at surprise attacks. At Mount Dingjun he fought hard against Liu Bei's army, but fell.
battleCry:
Let us raise the cup of our pledge...
to our kingdom of Wei!
victoryCryDuel: Xiahou Yuan stakes all on this one fight!!
victoryCryBattle: In this blood of mine flow Wei and Cao Cao!

skill.name: Wild Shots
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW and makes it shoot every enemy Unit within its bow range.
skill.shortDescription:
Raises POW and shoots
every enemy within range

name: Xiahou Dun
lore: From 'Souten Kouro' by King Gonta. The one-eyed demon general. He followed Cao Cao from the day he first raised troops and won merit in many battles. Close enough to call Cao Cao plainly 'Mengde', he always acted for Cao Cao's realm.
battleCry:
Xiahou Dun walks one road only:
the road to Cao Cao's realm!
victoryCryDuel: My one eye sees no dreams of the dead.
victoryCryBattle: Xiahou Dun walks one road: to Cao Cao's realm!

skill.name: One Eye Roar
skill.description: Briefly stops enemies in range from moving. This Unit's POW also rises: the more enemies in range, the bigger the increase. Once its POW has risen past a certain amount, its SPD rises too.
skill.shortDescription:
Halts enemies and raises POW
A big enough boost raises SPD too

name: Xu Chu
lore: From 'Souten Kouro' by King Gonta. Captain of Cao Cao's guard, of peerless strength. Ever at Cao Cao's side, he shielded him from Gan Ning's attack when Cao Cao faced death at Red Cliffs, and saved him from Ma Chao's surprise attack.
battleCry:
Mister Moon... there's gotta be
more than one of him, y'know!
victoryCryDuel: You won't get by in ten thousand years!
victoryCryBattle: Mister Moon's gotta be more than one, y'know!

skill.name: Tiger Strength
skill.description: Greatly raises this Unit's POW.

name: Xun Yu
lore: From 'Souten Kouro' by King Gonta. He had the gift of a king's right hand, fit to guide a lord to rule the realm. He followed Cao Cao as a strategist in the Yellow Turban Rebellion, later left to travel and learn, then returned to serve him.
battleCry:
In strategy, I do not bow to you, Sir.
Ask my mind, and decide by it alone.
victoryCryBattle: War has no fixed form, nor water a fixed shape.

skill.name: Mystery Counter
skill.description: [Deny] (Usable only when an enemy within range uses a Skill. A Deny can't be Denied.) Cancels the enemy's Skill. If that Skill deals damage, its effect is reflected back.
skill.shortDescription: Cancels the Skill and reflects damage

name: Xun You
lore: From 'Souten Kouro' by King Gonta. Xun Yu's nephew, though older than his uncle. Modest, yet spirited, with a tenacious grasp of strategy. At Red Cliffs, with Cao Cao away, he built a solid camp and stood ready for the Wu attack.
battleCry:
To win through the battle before you...
that is the way of Cao Cao's strategist.
victoryCryBattle: Cao Cao's strategist wins the battle at hand.

skill.name: Great Flood
skill.description: Deals water damage to enemies in range. The damage depends on this Unit's INT against the target's.

name: Xu Huang
lore: From 'Souten Kouro' by King Gonta. A jovial man known as 'Unbeaten Xu Huang', and quick to run when he had to: at Guandu he rode back to camp naked to stay light. He led armies with distinction at Red Cliffs, in Hanzhong and in Jing Province.
battleCry:
Yo-hooo!
The unbeaten Xu Huang has arrived!
victoryCryDuel: The unbeaten Xu Huang has arrived!
victoryCryBattle: My unbeaten legend goes on and on!

skill.name: Speed Tactics
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW and SPD.

name: Cao Ren
lore: From 'Souten Kouro' by King Gonta. Not trusted with an army in his youth, he grew into a great general and distinguished himself against Ma Chao and against Guan Yu in Jing Province.
battleCry:
This dead end is where
Cao Ren's true strength shows!
victoryCryDuel: Know the rage and grief of the Four Kings!
victoryCryBattle: All forces, mission complete!!

skill.name: Speed Tactics
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW and SPD.

name: Cao Cao
lore: From 'Souten Kouro' by King Gonta. An exceptional hero with the military and political skills of a ruler of the realm, and a gift for letters. Called 'the villainous hero of a chaotic age', he became King of Wei but never sought to be emperor.
battleCry:
My wars begin from utter weakness,
and in the end bring down even the mightiest.
victoryCryDuel: The fight ahead will be long and fierce.
victoryCryBattle: My war begins in weakness and fells the mighty.

skill.name: Lord's Appeal
skill.description: Raises the POW of all Wei allies in range.

name: Zhang Liao
lore: From 'Souten Kouro' by King Gonta. He served Lu Bu, and after Lu Bu's death joined Cao Cao in pursuit of 'supreme martial might'. At Hefei, with only a handful of men, he came within a hair of slaying Sun Quan, who led a vast army.
battleCry: I serve the mightiest.
victoryCryDuel: For the first time, a foe has touched me.
victoryCryBattle: Supreme might exists to pierce through fate!

skill.name: Speed Order
skill.description: Raises the POW of allies in range. Horse Units among them also gain SPD.
skill.shortDescription:
Raises ally POW
Horse Units also gain SPD

name: Ling Tong
lore: Wu's spearhead captain. At Hefei he fought like a raging lion so Sun Quan could escape, but all 300 of his men died and he barely made it back, gravely hurt. Sun Quan trusted him deeply and, hearing of his death, wept aloud before his men.
battleCry:
Say your goodbyes now.
I'll cut you down in an instant!
victoryCryDuel: Whoa, whoa! Thought I was done for there!
victoryCryBattle: Hope you lot are ready for what's coming!

skill.name: Vengeance
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW. The more allies are dead, the bigger the increase.
skill.shortDescription:
Raises POW
More dead allies, more POW

name: Zhao Yun
lore: One of Shu's Five Tiger Generals, distinguished at Changban and Hanzhong. After Liu Bei's death, he joined Zhuge Liang's Northern Campaigns, rallying troops and saving allies from defeat. Always calm, he earned Zhuge Liang's deep trust.
battleCry:
Shu's road to ruling the land...
my spear will carve it open!
victoryCryDuel: You were no match for my spear.
victoryCryBattle: On we go, riding this momentum!

skill.name: Long Spear
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW and lengthens its spear.

name: Dian Wei
lore: Cao Cao's bodyguard. A hero of unmatched strength who always protected his lord. Said to be impressive in appearance and modest in temperament. Mounted on his horse, he must have radiated an overwhelming, invincible presence.
victoryCryDuel: Raaaaaaagh!
victoryCryBattle: Raaaaaaagh!

skill.name: Wei Elite
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW for a long time.
skill.shortDescription: Raises POW for a long time

name: Wang Yi
lore: Wife of Zhao Ang, Inspector of Yi Province, and one of the great heroines of the Three Kingdoms. Against Ma Chao she took the field in person, and she had a hand in all nine stratagems that won the battle: a fierce woman of wits and courage.
battleCry:
Wolf of Xiliang...
I cannot allow your tyranny.
victoryCryDuel: Why are you in such a hurry to die?
victoryCryBattle: The real test starts now.

skill.name: Water Bane
skill.description: Deals water damage to enemies in range. The damage depends on this Unit's INT against the target's.

name: Xu Chu
lore: A Wei hero who guarded Cao Cao and saved him from crisis many times. During the war with Yuan Shao, assassins struck when he was away, but a premonition brought him running back in time to stop them.
battleCry: Come. You will not take one step past me...
victoryCryDuel: I won't forget your courage in facing me.
victoryCryBattle: I am proud to have fought you all!

skill.name: Tiger Strength
skill.description: Greatly raises this Unit's POW.

name: Xu Huang
lore: A famous general who won merit under Cao Cao in many battles, including Guandu and the campaign against Ma Chao. A steady man who excelled at spying out the enemy, yet bold when he saw his chance, pursuing without letting his men rest.
battleCry:
Now's the chance!
Pursue with all you've got! Keep up!
victoryCryDuel: The quickest way to win a battle, I'd say.
victoryCryBattle: Time to savor the taste of victory.

skill.name: Speed Tactics
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW and SPD.

name: Kuai Yue
lore: Aide to Liu Biao, Inspector of Jing Province. After Liu Biao died, he urged his heir Liu Cong to surrender to Cao Cao. Cao Cao is said to have been happier to gain Kuai Yue as a retainer than to gain Jing Province itself.
battleCry:
In peace, use benevolence.
In chaos, use stratagems.
victoryCryBattle: Is that all? How dull.

skill.name: Weaken Ploy
skill.description: Lowers the POW of enemies in range.

name: Xiahou Yuan
lore: Xiahou Dun's cousin and, like him, a veteran under Cao Cao. When Cao Cao broke the law, Xiahou Yuan took the blame and was arrested, but Cao Cao soon freed him. Unbeatable in battle but short-tempered, he was often cautioned by Cao Cao.
battleCry:
Cao Cao! This battle...
let me go first!
victoryCryDuel: Weak! No matter how often we fight, I win!
victoryCryBattle: Submit to our banner!

skill.name: Speed Extreme
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW and greatly raises its SPD.

name: Guan Yu
lore: When Cao Cao routed Liu Bei, Guan Yu, holding Xiapi, was persuaded by Zhang Liao to surrender to protect Liu Bei's wives. He repaid his debt to Cao Cao by slaying Yuan Shao's champion Yan Liang, then refused any reward and returned to Liu Bei.
battleCry:
All of my might...
I shall wield for my elder brother!
victoryCryDuel: Know the power of a god!
victoryCryBattle: Know the power of a god!

skill.name: Judgment Bolt
skill.description: Drops 4 lightning bolts in range, each dealing lightning damage to one of the enemies there. The damage depends on this Unit's INT against the target's.

name: Jiang Wei
lore: Originally a Wei officer at Tianshui. When Shu invaded, he saw through Zhuge Liang's tactics and pushed back Zhao Yun, but was finally captured and surrendered. Zhuge Liang rejoiced that gaining Jiang Wei was 'like gaining a phoenix.'
battleCry:
I must repay
the Chancellor's kindness!
victoryCryDuel: I cannot lose in a place like this!
victoryCryBattle: I have reasons why I must not lose!

skill.name: Prodigy Purge
skill.description: Greatly lowers the POW and SPD of enemies in range.
skill.shortDescription: Greatly lowers enemy POW and SPD

name: Huang Yueying
lore: Zhuge Liang's wife, a woman of rare talent. She knew astronomy, geography and military classics like the Six Secret Teachings and the Three Strategies. No one surpassed her as an inventor; she created many devices to aid her beloved husband.
battleCry:
Oh, welcome home, dear.
Would you take a look at this?
victoryCryDuel: Phew, that was close.
victoryCryBattle: We won!

skill.name: Loyal Troops
skill.description: Restores the HP of allies in range, even beyond the maximum.
skill.shortDescription: Restores ally HP beyond the maximum

name: Gongsun Zan
lore: He joined the Coalition against Dong Zhuo led by Yuan Shao. Handsome and talented, he studied the classics under Lu Zhi. A friend of Liu Bei from those days, he once lent him troops to go to the aid of the people of Xu Province.
battleCry: Did I keep you waiting...?
victoryCryDuel: Another head claimed.
victoryCryBattle: Now none dare oppose us.

skill.name: Mass Assault
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW. The more allied Units on the field, the bigger the increase.
skill.shortDescription:
Raises POW
More allies on the field, more POW

name: Sima Yi
lore: A senior Wei minister. In youth he studied hard, and noted men praised his insight and nerve. Summoned by Cao Cao, he won merit against Zhang Lu and Wu. He had the 'wolf's glance': he could turn his head 180 degrees without moving his body.
battleCry:
He who thinks more, wins.
That's all there is to it.
victoryCryBattle: Fuhaha! I am always the one who laughs last!

skill.name: Dispel Ploy
skill.description: Removes the effects of enemy Skills from enemy Units in range.

name: Zhou Cang
lore: Once an officer of the Yellow Turban Zhang Bao, he was won over by Guan Yu at first sight and became his right hand, following him everywhere. On hearing that Wu had captured and executed Guan Yu, Zhou Cang took his own life to follow him.
battleCry:
Master Guan Yu!
I'll follow you anywhere!
victoryCryDuel: Yeaaah!
victoryCryBattle: What a great fight!

skill.name: Fury Tactics
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW and restores its HP.

name: Xiao Qiao
lore: Zhou Yu's wife and Da Qiao's younger sister. The sisters were famed beauties known as the Two Qiaos. When Zhou Yu heard Cao Cao had sung of taking the Two Qiaos for his pleasure, he flew into a rage and resolved to fight at Red Cliffs.
battleCry: Everyone, please don't lose!
victoryCryDuel: Only because you led me by the hand.
victoryCryBattle: Oh... um, did I take the castle?

skill.name: Purify Ploy
skill.description: Removes the effects of enemy Skills from allies in range.
skill.shortDescription: Clears enemy Skill effects from allies

name: Cao Zhang
lore: Cao Cao's second son. Very strong, he loved martial arts and wrestled wild beasts. Caring nothing for power, he led 100,000 men from Changan to the capital when Cao Cao died, then handed them to his brother Cao Pi and went home to his fief.
battleCry: Come! I'll take you on!
victoryCryDuel: Yeaaaaaah, all right!!
victoryCryBattle: Yeaaaaaah, all right!!

skill.name: Kamikaze
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW and Siege power, but it is forced to advance while the effect lasts.
skill.shortDescription:
Raises POW and Siege power
but forces it to advance

name: Cao Pi
lore: Cao Cao's second son, later the first emperor of Wei. Gifted like his father, he mastered mounted archery at eight and marched against Zhang Xiu at eleven. Also clever, he became deputy to Chancellor Cao Cao and guarded Wei in his absence.
battleCry:
A realm made for me.
I need nothing else.
victoryCryDuel: Such sloppy moves won't beat me.
victoryCryBattle: Now then, time to head back.

skill.name: Capital Troops
skill.description: Restores the HP of Wei allies in range.

name: Sun Ren
lore: Half-sister of Sun Quan. Skilled in martial arts, she married Liu Bei in a political match. As bold as any man, she still lived in harmony with her older husband. On hearing of Liu Bei's death, she threw herself into the Yangzi.
battleCry:
Look down on me just because I'm a woman,
and you'll get hurt!
victoryCryDuel: A lady should know her way with a sword!
victoryCryBattle: Oh, this is the best!

skill.name: Paralyze Arrow
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW and bow range, and its arrows lower the SPD of the enemies they hit.
skill.shortDescription:
Raises POW and range
Its arrows lower enemy SPD

name: Taishi Ci
lore: A fierce warrior who swore loyalty to Sun Ce after a furious clash with him. Captured by Sun Ce and then set free, he gathered the scattered remnants of his old army and came back with them to serve his new lord, Sun Ce.
battleCry:
My dream of climbing the steps to the throne...
I leave it in your hands!
victoryCryDuel: I'll remember your name.
victoryCryBattle: Did you small fry think you could win?

skill.name: Flawless
skill.description: Greatly raises this Unit's POW and also raises its INT and SPD.
skill.shortDescription:
Greatly raises POW
and raises INT and SPD

name: Zhang Fei
lore: Sworn brother of Liu Bei and Guan Yu, a rough troublemaker. When Liu Bei won office for fighting the Yellow Turbans, Zhang Fei flogged a court envoy seeking a bribe, and they fled. An honest outlaw, he was loved by his brothers and the people.
battleCry:
Here stands Zhang Fei of Yan!
You won't get one step past me!
victoryCryDuel: I've broken through my limits!
victoryCryBattle: Remember the name Zhang Fei!

skill.name: Changban Roar
skill.description: Briefly stops enemies in range from moving. This Unit's POW also rises: the more enemies in range, the bigger the increase. Once its POW has risen past a certain amount, its SPD rises too.
skill.shortDescription:
Halts enemies and raises POW
A big enough boost raises SPD too

name: Ma Liang
lore: A Shu officer and Ma Su's elder brother. The finest of five gifted brothers, he was praised for his white eyebrows: 'White Brows is the best.' Recommended by Yi Ji, he served Liu Bei and was at Baidicheng with Zhuge Liang when Liu Bei died.
battleCry: Sir, please be patient.
victoryCryBattle: Surely that is enough. Surrender.

skill.name: Guard Thunder
skill.description: Drops 5 lightning bolts in range, each dealing lightning damage to one of the enemies there. The damage depends on this Unit's INT against the target's.

name: Lu Xun
lore: Of a powerful Jiangdong clan, he had both courage and intellect. After defeating Guan Yu in Jing Province with Lu Meng, he burned the Shu army at Yiling and turned back every Wei invasion. These feats made him Grand Commander, then Chancellor.
battleCry:
While Lu Xun lives,
none shall tread on Wu soil!
victoryCryDuel: Not as planned, but a happy chance to win.
victoryCryBattle: You cannot break the wisdom handed down in Wu.

skill.name: Yiling Flames
skill.description: Deals fire damage to enemies in range. The damage depends on this Unit's INT against the target's.

name: Lady Guo
lore: Her father called her Queen, the fairest of his daughters. Orphaned young, she was a maid when Cao Cao found her and wed her to Cao Pi. Childless, she adopted Cao Rui, whose mother Lady Zhen she had plotted to death, and he took his revenge.
battleCry: Heh heh heh... Now I am the princess.
victoryCryDuel: My, how weak.
victoryCryBattle: Fufufu, it's all mine now.

skill.name: Inspire Dance
skill.description: [Dance] (Once used, this Unit can't move, but the effect lasts until it dies.) Your MP fills faster.

name: Lady Gan
lore: Liu Bei's second wife and Liu Shan's mother, wed while he held Xiaopei. At Changban, Zhao Yun saved her and Liu Shan from Cao Cao's army. She quietly supported Liu Bei and died young in Jing Province; Zhuge Liang later entombed her with him.
battleCry:
Oh my, what happened?
Another injury?
victoryCryDuel: See? Things do work out somehow...
victoryCryBattle: Hee hee, thanks for letting me win!

skill.name: Loyal Troops
skill.description: Restores the HP of allies in range, even beyond the maximum.
skill.shortDescription: Restores ally HP beyond the maximum

name: Chunyu Qiong
lore: A peer of Cao Cao and Yuan Shao under He Jin, he joined Yuan Shao when He Jin's force broke up. At Guandu, Cao Cao caught him dead drunk; he lost his ears, nose and fingers and was sent back to Yuan Shao, who had him cut down for the blunder.
battleCry:
My fine features
are surely Heaven's gift.
victoryCryDuel: Feel the pain of my wounds! Feeeel it!
victoryCryBattle: Feel the pain of my wounds! Feeeel it!

skill.name: Rebel Signal
skill.description: Greatly raises this Unit's POW. On activation, one of your other Units on the field dies. If there is no other Unit to die, the effect is weaker.
skill.shortDescription:
Greatly raises POW
but 1 other ally dies

name: Diao Chan
lore: One of China's Four Beauties. Adopted daughter of Wang Yun, she repaid him by aiding his scheme to set Dong Zhuo and Lu Bu against each other. After Dong Zhuo died she stayed with Lu Bu and was captured with him when Cao Cao defeated him.
battleCry:
Lu, dear.
If you want to be with me,
go and beat that guy!
victoryCryDuel: Ascend to heaven.
victoryCryBattle: Get too close and you'll get burned.

skill.name: Provoke
skill.description: Makes every enemy in range move toward this Unit.

name: Ma Dai
lore: Nephew of Ma Teng and cousin of Ma Chao. He saw through Cao Cao's summons of Ma Teng and warned him, in vain; Ma Teng was killed. When Liu Bei invaded Shu, Ma Dai fought for Zhang Lu and wounded Wei Yan with an arrow, sowing a fateful feud.
battleCry: I will protect the Ma clan!
victoryCryDuel: I can't be losing in a place like this!
victoryCryBattle: Know the bitter regret of our clan!

skill.name: See Through
skill.description: [Deny] (Usable only when an enemy within range uses a Skill. A Deny can't be Denied.) Cancels the enemy's Skill.

name: Yue Jin
lore: A brave general risen through the ranks of Cao Cao's army. Small but fearless, he was always first into battle. At Guandu he slew Yuan Shao's officer Chunyu Qiong, and garrisoned at Hefei he drove back the Wu army with Zhang Liao and Li Dian.
battleCry:
Forward, men!
This army does not know the word 'retreat'!
victoryCryDuel: Did you think you could halt my advance?!
victoryCryBattle: Retreat is not in my vocabulary!

skill.name: Speed Tactics
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW and SPD.

name: Jiang Wei
lore: Zhuge Liang's prized disciple, a scholar and warrior who matched Zhao Yun in a clash. As Shu's Grand General after Zhuge Liang, he fought on against Wei to little effect. His revolt with Wei's Zhong Hui failed, and Wei troops cut him down.
battleCry:
Your last wish, to bring down Wei...
I have taken it up as my own.
victoryCryDuel: Couldn't read my spear, could you?
victoryCryBattle: The battle is over. Bring in the wounded.

skill.name: Provoke
skill.description: Makes every enemy in range move toward this Unit.

name: Sun Ren
lore: Wife of Liu Bei and younger sister of Sun Quan of Wu, wed to him in a political marriage. As bold as any man and a fine warrior, she always kept maids bearing glaives in her chambers. Liu Bei was said to be a nervous wreck around her.
battleCry:
Come on!
Aren't you supposed to be the realm's great hero?
Straighten up, I say, straighten up!
victoryCryDuel: I do train, you know!
victoryCryBattle: I won't lose that easily!

skill.name: Fury Tactics
skill.description: Raises this Unit's POW and restores its HP.

name: Lu Lingqi
lore: Lu Bu's daughter. To deepen their alliance, Lu Bu and Yuan Shu planned to marry her to Yuan Shu's son. But with Lu Bu's blood in her veins, she would never meekly say 'Yes, Father'; she refused and ran wild, and the match turned into a war.
battleCry:
Being cute isn't enough
to survive an age of chaos!
victoryCryDuel: Must've been a bad dream.
victoryCryBattle: I carve my own destiny!

skill.name: Unrivaled+
skill.description: Greatly raises this Unit's POW. It also restores its HP and raises its SPD.
skill.shortDescription:
Raises POW and SPD
and restores HP
